title: TC-CS-CTM-Pentesting-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Position Title: Attack & Penetration Testing – Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
As part of our Cyber Security team, you shall perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, wireless, web application, social engineering and physical penetration testing. You shall also perform in-depth analysis of penetration testing results and create report that describes findings, exploitation procedures, risks and recommendations.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Security Consultant / Senior Security Consultant with expertise in penetration testing. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, web application, wireless, social engineering, physical penetration testing.
* Execute penetration testing projects using the established methodology, tools and rules of engagements.
* Execute red team assessments to highlight gaps impacting organizations security postures.
* Identify and exploit security vulnerabilities in a wide array of systems in a variety of situations.
* Perform in-depth analysis of penetration testing results and create report that describes findings, exploitation procedures, risks and recommendations.
* Convey complex technical security concepts to technical and non-technical audiences including executives.
* Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10 web and the ability to effectively communicate methodologies and techniques with development teams
* Understanding and experience with Active Directory attacks.
* Understanding of TCP/IP network protocols.
* Develop automated solutions that mitigate risks throughout the organization.
* Ability to automate DAST/SAST solutions and reporting
* Support SDLC and agile environments with application security testing and source code reviews.
* Provide technical leadership and advise to junior team members on attack and penetration test engagements.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Understanding of web-based application vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10).
* Good understanding of enterprise security controls in Active Directory / Windows environments
* Understanding of TCP/IP network protocols.
* Understanding of network security and popular attacks vectors.
* Ability to communicate detailed technical information to a non-technical audience clearly
* Experience with Operation Technology / Internet of Things, Cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP), Active Directory and 802.1x penetration testing
* Strong understanding of security principles, policies, and industry best practices
* Demonstrable flair for technical writing, including engagement reports, presentations and operating procedures

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* BE/ B.Tech/ MCA or equivalent
* Minimum of 3-4 years of work experience in penetration testing which may include at least three of the following: internet, intranet, web application penetration tests, wireless, social engineering, physical and Red Team assessments.
* One of the following certifications: OSCP, OSCE, OSEP, OSWE, CREST, CRTE, eCPTX, or eWPTX
* Knowledge of Windows, Linux, UNIX, any other major operating systems.
* 3-4 years of work experience in Strategy and Operations projects
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Project management skills
* Certifications: CISSP, GPEN, GWAPT.

**What We Look For**

* Who can perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, wireless, web application, social engineering and physical penetration testing and provide analysis for the testing results.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Principal Cyber Security Test Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced application security engineer who will champion a shift-left security philosophy by
**integrating automated security analysis into CI/CD pipelines, SAST scanning, GitHub Actions, and SCA.**
To ensure
**we embed security into the software development lifecycle (SDLC) across the organisation’s .NET, Java, and Node.js technology stacks.**
This role is also needed to run web application security assessments or penetration tests.

**What You Will Do:**

* **Threat Modelling**
* **Code reviews**
* Supporting engineering teams with security related design and build issues
* Reviewing the results from various security code scanning tools
* Reviewing CI/CD pipeline configurations
* Create or amend code and generate pull requests for code fixes
* Reviewing and testing AI integrations and relevant guard rails etc
* Assisting other members of the team with application security related issues
* Completing web and desktop security assessments
* Carrying out risk assessments using the IRAM2 methodology
* Attending architecture board technical reviews

**Success Measures:**

* Number of threat models completed
* Number of penetration tests completed
* Number of engagements on AI and Software Engineering Projects
* Number of risk assessments completed

**What You Will Have:**

* **5+ years**
  of experience in application security, software engineering, or DevSecOps.
* Proven
  **hands-on experience securing applications built with .NET, Java, and Node.js.**
* Demonstrable expertise administering SAST scanning at enterprise scale (multi-project, multi-language).
* Experience implementing and managing SCA tooling, ideally Harness, across large codebases.
* Strong working knowledge of GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines and GitHub Advanced Security features.
* Experience configuring and using IAST and RASP technologies
* Deep understanding of common vulnerability classes (injection, broken access control, cryptographic failures, SSRF, etc.).
* Ability to execute on web and desktop penetration tests.
* Demonstrable expertise securing the embedding and implementation of AI within applications

**Desirable:**

* Relevant certifications: CSSLP, GWEB, GWAPT, CEH, OSCP or equivalent.
* Experience with additional SAST/DAST/IAST/RASP tools (Checkmarx, Snyk, Veracode, Contrast Security).
* Contributions to open-source security projects or published security research.
* Familiarity with regulatory frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR) as they relate to application security.
* Experience with Kubernetes security and service-mesh architectures.

**What We Do For You**

* Wellbeing focused – Our people are our greatest assets, and ensuring everyone feels their best self to come to work is integral.
* Annual Leave – 20 days of annual leave, plus public holidays
* Employee Assistance Programme – Free advice, support, and confidential counselling available 24/7.
* Personal Growth - Regardless of where you are at in your career, we’re committed to enabling your growth personally and professionally
* Development Programmes – From Future Managers to Leadership Training, our development programmes help you get where you need to go
* Online Learning Platform: SkillsHub! - Learning at your fingertips, anytime from anywhere. You can access our online library with relevant content for your career growth.
* Life Insurance - 3x annual salary
* Personal Accident Insurance - providing cover in the event of serious injury/illness.
* Performance Bonus – Our Group-wide bonus scheme enables you to reap the rewards of your success

**Who We Are**

At OneAdvanced, we are at the forefront of delivering sector-focused technology solutions that simplify complexity, drive meaningful progress, and help build a fairer, more inclusive society.

We’re much more than a software company. We deliver SaaS workflow applications and IT services that power organisations across Education, Government, Healthcare, Legal, Manufacturing, Housing, Retail, and more.

OneAdvanced is one of the UK’s largest business software and services companies. Based in Birmingham (The Mailbox), operating across the UK, Ireland, India, and Australia.

Our secure, scalable platform, including OneAdvanced AI, our private AI service for UK organisations, powers connectivity and innovation across critical sectors. Alongside our software are our IT services, including hosting, managed services, and application modernisation.

We strive to create an inclusive workplace that drives innovation and collaboration, championing diverse perspectives and ideas. Our Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) strategy is embedded in everything we do, guiding us to create meaningful impact for our people, our customers and the planet.

Join us and become part of a team that’s powering the world of work and making a real difference.

Learn more at
**www.oneadvanced.com**

title: Principal Red Team Operator
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The Principal Red Team Operator will lead workstreams within Red Team and act as a subject matter expert for the capability. This is a senior hands-on offensive security role.
  
  
**About the team**
. The Red Team emulates real adversaries against GSK. Operators run full-lifecycle engagements using real-world attacker tradecraft, then measure what GSK's defenders actually detect and how they respond.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**
This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
  
  

* Lead assigned workstreams from definition through delivery.
* Act as subject matter expert for the capability and advise stakeholders across GSK.
* Mentor colleagues and review their technical or analytical work.
* Execute red team engagements across a variety of networks using real-world adversarial tactics, techniques and procedures, from conception through to report delivery.
* Emulate real attackers to simulate security incidents, then observe and measure how GSK's monitoring and incident response perform.
* Develop after-action reports stating what was achieved, what was detected, what was missed and what should change.
* Build and maintain red team infrastructure, including command and control, redirectors and payload delivery, with operational security discipline.
* Develop custom tooling and exploits where off-the-shelf capability is insufficient or too well signatured.
* Run purple team exercises with the Cyber Defense team to convert findings into detection coverage.
* Map engagement activity to MITRE ATT&CK so coverage gaps are expressed in a common language.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Degree in a relevant discipline, or related experience.
* Demonstrated experience in offensive security and red team operations.
* Working knowledge of adversary tradecraft and command and control frameworks.
* Practical experience with full-lifecycle engagement delivery.
* Strong practical experience in the relevant cyber security domain.
* Proven experience leading workstreams and delivering high-quality outcomes.
* Ability to act as a subject matter expert and advise stakeholders confidently.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* OSCP, OSEP, OSED, CRTO, GPEN or GXPN.
* Exploit development capability.
* Active Directory and cloud attack path expertise.
* Experience with detection evasion within an authorised engagement.
* Experience in a regulated industry, including OT and clinical system awareness.
* Relevant certification such as OSCP, OSEP, CRTO, GPEN, GXPN.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or another highly regulated industry.
* Typical tools and technologies: command and control frameworks, custom offensive tooling, Active Directory and cloud attack tooling, MITRE ATT&CK.

#AGTech
  
  
**Skills**
Adversary Simulation, AI for Cybersecurity, AI Red Teaming, Cloud Security, COSO Framework, Cyber Threat Intelligence, Forensic Data Analysis, Incident Management, Infrastructure Security, Intrusion Detection, Intrusion Prevention, ML Security, Offensive Cyber Operations, Red Teaming, Security Monitoring, Security Operations, Security Planning, Security Protocols, Security Risk, Security Technologies, Tradecraft
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.
  
  
It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
  
  
**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**
If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About Our Cybersecurity Team**
Are you ready to make an impact at one of the world’s leading technology companies? HPE’s Cybersecurity team is where you can do just that. We’re looking for a dynamic and experienced Security Operations Engineer to join our team. If you’re passionate about shaping the future of cybersecurity and ready for your next challenge, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Security Operations Engineer at HPE, you will be responsible for Web Application and API Protection (WAAP) administration. You will serve as a technical lead for the administration, optimization, and continuous improvement of the WAAP platform to protect web applications and APIs from cyber threats while partnering with application, infrastructure, and security teams to enhance the organization's security posture. You will apply your knowledge of Application Security, WAF administration, API Security and Networking to protect HPE’s web applications and APIs.
  
  
**About You**
You will bring expertise in Application Security and WAF Administration tools and platforms to protect HPE’s web applications and APIs. You will work independently and contribute to high-impact projects in fast-paced environments, applying advanced expertise across cybersecurity and IT security.
  
  
Your experience with Application Security, WAF administration, API Security, and Networking will be critical. Strong communication skills are essential, enabling you to explain complex technical issues clearly to non-technical audiences.
  
  
You are energized by building capabilities that do not yet exist. You are comfortable working through ambiguity, identifying gaps in current processes or tooling, and creating solutions that scale beyond individual applications or teams. You measure success not only by operational excellence, but by the lasting improvements, automation, standards, and security outcomes that continue delivering value over time.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
You Will Be Responsible For
  
  

* Administering, maintaining, and optimizing the Web Application and API Protection (WAAP) platform, including web application firewall (WAF), API security, bot protection, and DDoS mitigation capabilities.
* Monitoring and analyzing application traffic to identify, investigate, and mitigate security threats targeting internet-facing applications and APIs.
* Configuring, tuning, and maintaining WAF policies, security rules, signatures, and exceptions to maximize protection while minimizing false positives.
* Partnering with application development, infrastructure, and cloud engineering teams to securely onboard and protect new applications and APIs.
* Reviewing security events, alerts, and logs to investigate suspicious activity and support incident response efforts.
* Performing traffic analysis and troubleshooting to resolve application availability, performance, and security issues.
* Conducting security assessments of web applications and APIs and providing recommendations to remediate identified risks and vulnerabilities.
* Developing and maintaining operational documentation, standard operating procedures, and configuration standards for WAAP technologies.
* Supporting the implementation of bot management, account takeover protection, and API security controls to address evolving threats.
* Integrating WAAP technologies with SIEM, SOAR, and other security monitoring platforms to improve visibility and response capabilities.
* Participating in change management processes and performing testing and validation of security policy updates before production deployment.
* Collaborating with security architecture and application security teams to continuously improve the organization’s application security posture.

Success Outcomes
  
  

* Critical applications and APIs are onboarded to WAAP and protected by appropriate WAF, API security, bot mitigation, and DDoS controls.
* Application onboarding is faster, repeatable, and supported by clear standards and ownership.
* Security policies maintain strong protection while keeping false positives and disruption to legitimate traffic within agreed thresholds.
* API security controls are applied consistently across relevant environments, with gaps identified and remediated.
* WAAP-related incidents and misconfigurations are resolved quickly, with minimal impact on application availability.
* Repeatable monitoring, runbooks, dashboards, and automation reduce manual effort and improve operational response.
* Leadership has clear visibility of platform coverage, control effectiveness, operational performance, and risk reduction.

**What You Need To Bring**
Education & Experience Requirements
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience, is desired.
* 6+ years of cybersecurity experience, with a focus on web application security, network security, and cybersecurity engineering functions, desired.
* Proven experience in Web Application Firewall (WAF) / Web Application and API Protection (WAAP) technologies.
* Strong understanding of web application security concepts, including the OWASP Top 10 and common web-based attack techniques.
* Experience analyzing HTTP/S traffic, web application logs, and security events.
* Experience working with API technologies, including REST, JSON, OAuth, JWT, and API authentication mechanisms.
* Experience supporting security monitoring, threat detection, incident response, or vulnerability management activities.

**Desired**

* Experience administering Imperva WAAP, Imperva WAF, or other enterprise WAAP solutions.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience with bot mitigation, API security, and DDoS protection technologies.
* Experience with scripting or automation using Python, PowerShell, or REST APIs.
* Industry certifications such as CISSP, Security+, GSEC, GWAPT, CCSP, AZ-500, or AWS Security Specialty.

title: Senior Cyber Security Specialist
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
  
  
This Position reports to:
  
  
R&D Team Lead
  
  
  
  
  
**Your role and responsibilities :**
We are seeking a skilled Senior Cybersecurity Specialist with deep knowledge of product security, secure software development, and cybersecurity engineering to join our team. You will manage the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of cybersecurity controls for digital products and solutions, ensuring they are secure, resilient, and compliant with applicable cybersecurity standards and regulations. This role requires a unique combination of security engineering knowledge, risk management, threat modeling, and software development lifecycle security to deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable products in production environments.
  
  
The work model for the role is:
  
  
This role is contributing to the Motion Business Service Division in Bangalore India.
  
  
**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Own the secure software development lifecycle and guide the product team to implement the security practices at different stages of the software development process.
* Own software supply chain security, including defenses against risks from open-source packages, third-party binaries, container base images, build tools, and other software dependencies.
* Own first-party software security, including code and container scanning, automated security testing in CI, external penetration tests, and the integrity and provenance of software we build and publish.
* Own and run the responsible vulnerability disclosure program, including triaging external reports, maintaining submission quality standards, and scaling the review process.
* Partner with engineering teams from concept through implementation to conduct security design reviews, define secure architectures, and ensure security best practices are followed.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Product Security & Secure SDLC: 10+ years of experience across software engineering, application security, security engineering, or product security, with deep knowledge of Secure SDLC, Secure by Design, Secure by Default, OWASP, ISO 27001, NIST SP 800-53, and IEC 62443-4-2 standards.
* Security Architecture & Risk Assessment: Experience in conducting secure design and architecture reviews, developing reusable security reference architectures and security blueprints aligned with Microsoft Security Baselines and Bow-Tie models, and performing product security risk assessments.
* Threat Modeling & Security Analysis: Proficiency in STRIDE, DREAD, PASTA, and MITRE ATT&CK frameworks, with experience using tools such as IriusRisk and Microsoft Threat Modeling Tool to identify threats, assess risks, and define mitigations.
* DevSecOps & Application Security: Practical experience integrating security into CI/CD pipelines, including SAST (SonarQube, WizCode), SCA (Black Duck Hub), DAST and vulnerability scanning (Nmap, Nessus, Qualys, Burp Suite), and SBOM generation and management using OWASP Dependency-Track.
* Cloud & Platform Security: Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures, microservices, Kubernetes, containers, and multi-tenant SaaS environments, with practical knowledge of security controls across Microsoft Azure, AWS, and GCP.
* Identity, Authentication & Cryptography: Solid knowledge of authentication and authorization protocols, including OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0, SAML, and mTLS, along with cryptographic protocols and algorithms such as TLS, AES, RSA, ChaCha20-Poly1305, SHA, ECC, and Diffie-Hellman key exchange.
* Vulnerability Management & Governance: Proven experience in vulnerability triaging, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, product risk remediation, and GRC activities aligned with ISO 27005, NIST SP 800-37, SOX, GDPR, the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), and IEC 62443.
* Leadership, Collaboration & Security Enablement: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, with demonstrated ability to influence engineering and product leadership, define security policies and secure coding standards, deliver security awareness and secure coding training, and communicate technical risks effectively to executive stakeholders.

title: Principal Engineer - VMS I On-site, Bangalore
description:
*This position is required to be on-site at our Bangalore office 3 days per week*
The Principal Engineer – Exposure Management will serve as a senior technical leader and subject matter expert responsible for advancing the organization’s
**Exposure Management capabilities across infrastructure, cloud, applications, containers, and modern technology environments**
.
  
  
The role will be responsible for developing technical standards, procedures, and scalable operational processes for continuously identifying, assessing, validating, prioritizing, and reducing security exposures across internal and client environments.
  
  
The Principal Engineer will work closely with Management, Solution Architects, Senior Engineers, Security Engineers, application and cloud teams, other Principal Engineers, and clients to deliver and mature high-profile Managed Security Services.
  
  
This individual will provide technical leadership across the entire exposure lifecycle, helping move security programs beyond isolated vulnerability findings toward a
**risk-based view of exploitable exposure**
, incorporating technical severity, asset criticality, threat intelligence, business context, cloud posture, application risk, and compensating controls.
  
  
The Principal Engineer will also serve as a technical escalation point, mentor engineering staff, drive automation and service improvements, and help establish consistent Exposure Management practices across client environments.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Provide technical leadership for Exposure Management services across infrastructure, endpoints, networks, operating systems, cloud platforms, applications, APIs, containers, Kubernetes, and software dependencies.
* Define and continuously improve the end-to-end Exposure Management lifecycle covering discovery, assessment, validation, contextualization, prioritization, remediation, reporting, and continuous improvement.
* Design and maintain assessment policies, security baselines, scan configurations, credentials, schedules, coverage standards, and technical procedures across supported security platforms.
* Lead the identification and management of security exposures including software vulnerabilities, application weaknesses, cloud misconfigurations, insecure configurations, vulnerable dependencies, exposed services, container risks, and other technology weaknesses.
* Establish risk-based prioritization methodologies that consider factors such as severity, exploitability, active exploitation, asset criticality, external exposure, business impact, application context, threat intelligence, and available compensating controls.
* Analyze and validate security findings to improve accuracy, eliminate false positives and duplicate findings, identify systemic risk, and ensure remediation efforts focus on meaningful security exposures.
* Work closely with infrastructure, cloud, application, DevOps, networking, platform, and security teams to translate exposure findings into clear and actionable remediation activities.
* Provide technical leadership for enterprise security assessment technologies and capabilities including network and agent scanning, credentialed assessments, cloud posture assessment, application security testing, dependency analysis, container security, API security, and Infrastructure-as-Code security.
* Support the integration of security assessments into modern engineering and DevSecOps workflows, helping identify and remediate exposures earlier in the technology and application lifecycle.
* Define and maintain technical integrations between Exposure Management technologies and enterprise platforms such as SIEM, SOAR, ITSM, CMDB, CI/CD, asset management, and risk-management systems.
* Develop dashboards and reporting that provide meaningful visibility into overall exposure, remediation progress, aging, coverage, trends, SLA performance, recurring weaknesses, and risk reduction.
* Establish metrics and KPIs that measure the effectiveness and maturity of Exposure Management rather than focusing solely on the volume of vulnerabilities or findings.
* Identify opportunities for automation and orchestration across discovery, enrichment, validation, prioritization, assignment, remediation tracking, exception management, and reporting.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex issues involving scanning, integrations, assessment coverage, credentials, policies, cloud configurations, application testing, asset identification, and reporting.
* Support the onboarding of new clients, technologies, applications, cloud environments, and security platforms into the Exposure Management service.
* Evaluate emerging Exposure Management technologies and capabilities and provide technical recommendations for service enhancement and technology adoption.
* Develop and maintain engineering standards, operating procedures, runbooks, implementation guides, knowledge articles, and technical documentation.
* Provide technical mentoring and knowledge transfer to engineers and analysts, helping develop deeper expertise across infrastructure, cloud, and application security disciplines.
* Serve as a senior technical advisor during client security reviews, technical workshops, escalations, architecture discussions, and service improvement initiatives.
* Stay current with emerging vulnerabilities, exploitation techniques, application security risks, cloud security threats, attack-surface trends, and evolving Exposure Management practices.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of relevant cybersecurity experience, with significant experience across vulnerability management, security engineering, cloud security, application security, or related security disciplines.
* 6+ years of hands-on experience implementing, managing, or engineering enterprise security assessment and Exposure Management technologies.
* Strong understanding of the complete vulnerability and exposure lifecycle, including asset discovery, assessment, validation, risk prioritization, remediation, exception management, and measurement.
* Experience assessing diverse enterprise environments including Windows, Linux/Unix, network devices, virtualized infrastructure, AWS, Microsoft Azure, containers, Kubernetes, applications, APIs, and cloud workloads.
* Hands-on experience with enterprise vulnerability or exposure technologies such as Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, Brinqa, Lumin, Nmap, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience with cloud security and posture-management technologies such as Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Orca Security, or equivalent CSPM/CNAPP capabilities.
* Experience with application security capabilities including SAST, DAST, Software Composition Analysis (SCA), API security, secrets detection, container scanning, and Infrastructure-as-Code security.
* Experience with application security technologies such as Checkmarx, Veracode, Snyk, GitHub Advanced Security, Black Duck, Burp Suite Enterprise, or equivalent platforms is desirable.
* Strong understanding of risk-based prioritization and the ability to combine vulnerability severity with asset importance, exploitability, exposure, threat intelligence, business context, and compensating controls.
* Understanding of industry security standards and frameworks including CVE, CVSS, CWE, CISA KEV, OWASP Top 10, CIS Benchmarks, NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and PCI DSS.
* Experience establishing metrics and dashboards capable of communicating technical risk, remediation progress, coverage, service performance, and security posture to both technical and executive audiences.
* Experience integrating security platforms with technologies such as ITSM, SIEM, SOAR, CMDB, CI/CD, asset inventory, and reporting platforms.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to work across complex and heterogeneous enterprise environments.
* Ability to translate large volumes of technical security findings into prioritized, actionable risk-reduction activities.
* Strong understanding of security architecture, networking, cloud architectures, modern application architectures, containers, DevOps, and enterprise infrastructure.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives and provide technical direction to engineers without requiring direct management responsibility.
* Ability to foster collaborative working relationships across Security, Infrastructure, Cloud, Application Development, DevOps, Architecture, and business stakeholders.
* Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical exposure and risk to both engineering and leadership audiences.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**What You Can Expect From Optiv**

* Work/life balance
* Professional training resources
* Creative problem-solving and the ability to tackle unique, complex projects
* Volunteer Opportunities. “Optiv Chips In” encourages employees to volunteer and engage with their teams and communities.

Role: Senior DevSecOps Engineer (On-Prem / BFSI)

**About Bluno**
Bluno is an intelligent layer global trade runs on. A unified intelligent platform — the world’s first of its kind — Bluno embeds directly into exporter and importer workflows, eliminating the fragmented systems and document-heavy processes that have made trade
  
  
complex, slow, and expensive. Empowering businesses to focus entirely on growth, while Bluno handles the
  
  
rest.
  
  
Our mission: make global trade as seamless as doing business locally.
  
  
THE OPPORTUNITY
  
  
Bluno is live across India’s key export hubs — and aggressively scaling into new markets. This role sits at the centre of that ambition. You will own the security posture of Bluno’s cloud and hybrid infrastructure end-to- end — building and enforcing the controls that keep sensitive trade and transaction data safe, and that meet the security expectations of the financial institutions Bluno integrates with.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design the architecture of Bluno’s cloud and hybrid infrastructure, and the security controls built into it.
* Own infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, and multi-account governance on AWS — Terraform, Ansible or Chef, least-privilege IAM, and cost and capacity discipline.
* Provision and operate on-premise and hybrid infrastructure where data residency requires workloads to remain in-country, including hybrid connectivity and network coordination.
* Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines with security embedded rather than appended — static, dynamic, dependency, container, and infrastructure scanning — tuned so gates block what matters without obstructing delivery.
* Own secrets and encryption key management across environments, and ensure credentials never reach source control.
* Own software supply chain security end-to-end — dependency and base-image hygiene, build integrity and provenance, software bill of materials and artifact signing, and a governed artifact registry.
* Implement and maintain day-to-day SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls — access reviews, logging, evidence collection, and continuous control monitoring — and uphold data residency requirements.
* Own reliability alongside security: define and monitor SLOs, run observability, lead the on-call rotation, and drive incident response.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5–7 years in DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering, including 2–3 years of direct security engineering ownership.
* Deep, hands-on AWS experience — including EKS, Kubernetes, and Docker — with strong Terraform and CI/CD practice (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI) Azure or GCP exposure is a plus.
* Proven ability to design infrastructure architecture for security, scale, and resilience.
* Production experience operating on-premise or hybrid infrastructure under data residency constraints.

title: CNAPP / Wiz Security Engineering Lead
description:
World leading global engineering consultancy has vacancy in the security division for a CNAPP lead in a global role

CNAPP Security Engineer

Wiz platform engineering- Cloud Application Protection Platform

Department: Security Engineering  |  Reports to: Head of Security Engineering

Location Bangalore  |  Employment type Perm

Role purpose

We are seeking a Senior Cloud Security Engineer to own the deployment, engineering and continuous improvement of Wiz across our cloud estate. You will turn cloud risk findings into tested controls, automated workflows and verified fixes, working with Cloud Engineering, DevSecOps, IAM, Security Operations and application teams. The initial technology focus is Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.

You will be a senior individual contributor within Security Engineering, responsible for the technical quality, coverage and effectiveness of the Wiz service.

Key responsibilitiesDeploy and maintain CNAPP & Wiz Platforms

·  Implement cloud onboarding across Azure subscriptions and OCI tenancies and compartments. Establish repeatable deployment patterns, validate supported resource coverage and reconcile discovered assets against authoritative cloud inventories.

·  Configure tenant access, projects, resource ownership, SSO and role based access. Maintain least privilege connector permissions and API credentials, monitor connector health and scan freshness, and resolve scanning or integration failures.

Engineer security controls

·  Configure and tune posture, vulnerability and identity controls. Develop custom Cloud Configuration Rules using Rego, Security Graph queries and issue policies, with documented logic, representative test cases and controlled releases.

·  Use the Wiz Security Graph to investigate attack paths and combinations of internet exposure, exploitable vulnerabilities, excessive permissions, secrets and sensitive data. Validate findings against the underlying cloud configuration and business context.

Deliver remediation and prevent recurrence

·  Prioritise exposures using exploitability, asset criticality, external reachability, privilege and data sensitivity. Assign accountable owners, agree remediation deadlines and escalate material risks through the defined governance process.

·  Develop and test fixes with cloud and application owners, including infrastructure as code changes, identity restrictions and network controls. Verify closure through rescanning and source configuration evidence, and address the causes of repeated findings.

Key responsibilities continuedBuild integrations and automation

·  Develop maintainable automation using Python or PowerShell and the Wiz GraphQL API. Automate onboarding, ownership mapping, enrichment, evidence collection and reporting, with secure authentication, logging, error handling and version control.

·  Integrate Wiz findings and relevant events with Microsoft Sentinel and the organisation’s ITSM and DevOps workflows using supported connectors or APIs. Implement deduplication, routing, escalation and status reconciliation so remediation can be tracked through verified closure.

Embed controls in development and cloud platforms

·  Integrate licensed Wiz Code and CLI capabilities into Azure DevOps repositories and pipelines for infrastructure as code, container image, dependency and secrets checks. Coordinate coverage with existing application security scanners and agree proportionate release gates.

·  Translate recurring findings into preventive controls within cloud platforms, reusable deployment templates and developer guidance. Maintain assessment of deployed resources so security visibility also covers resources created outside standard delivery workflows.

Extend workload and data coverage

·  Assess security across virtual machines, containers, Kubernetes and serverless services, including identity, storage, networking and secrets exposure. Identify unsupported services and coverage gaps and agree compensating controls with the relevant teams.

·  Where licensed and supported, implement data security posture management and Wiz Defend capabilities, including required sensors and log sources. Validate deployment impact, data handling and operating responsibilities before extending coverage.

·  Provide cloud asset and attack path context to Security Operations during investigations. Agree escalation and handover procedures and work with existing endpoint, SIEM and cloud native security capabilities.

Provide governance and engineering enablement

·  Produce technical and management reporting on coverage, scan health, critical attack paths, overdue exposure, remediation times, repeat findings and exceptions. Explain the risk and required action in terms appropriate to each audience.

·  Map technical checks to relevant CIS, ISO 27001 and internal control requirements, including ITGC and SOX evidence where applicable. Maintain documented exceptions with accountable owners, expiry dates and compensating controls.

·  Maintain architecture records, operating procedures and a prioritised improvement backlog. Train engineering teams, manage technical escalations with Wiz and evaluate new capabilities against the organisation’s risks and requirements.

Essential experience and skills

·  Demonstrable experience implementing and administering CNAPP platforms in particular Wiz in a production enterprise environment, including cloud connectors, access controls, policy configuration, finding investigation, integrations and remediation workflows.

·  Strong hands on Azure security engineering experience covering Entra ID, Azure RBAC, managed identities, networking, storage, compute and cloud logging. Ability to apply these principles across a multi cloud estate.

·  Practical understanding of cloud security posture management, cloud infrastructure entitlement management, vulnerability management and attack path analysis, with examples of reducing material risk.

·  Experience authoring or adapting Wiz custom controls and queries, including Rego or comparable policy as code skills, and validating that controls identify the intended risks.

·  Ability to build and support automation using Python or PowerShell, APIs, JSON and Git. Experience integrating security tooling with ITSM, SIEM or engineering delivery platforms.

·  Experience reading and changing infrastructure as code using Bicep, ARM or Terraform, and integrating security checks into Azure DevOps or a comparable CI/CD platform.

·  Working knowledge of container, Kubernetes and serverless security, including workload identities, exposed services, image vulnerabilities and secrets handling.

·  Ability to investigate findings, propose practical fixes, work through technical disagreements and communicate clearly with engineers, risk owners and leadership.

Desirable experience

·  Multi-cloud security engineering experience across IAM policies, compartments, dynamic groups, virtual cloud networks and native security services; experience supporting Wiz coverage

·  Microsoft Sentinel, KQL and Defender for Cloud integrations; ServiceNow or Jira remediation workflows; enterprise asset inventories and ownership data.

·  Wiz Code, Wiz Defend, data security posture management, sensitive data exposure analysis or security assessment of cloud hosted AI services.

·  Large or regulated cloud estates, control assurance and audit evidence; relevant Wiz training, cloud security certifications or CCSP.

title: Application Security Lead
description:
About the role

HTS Consulting is hiring a hands-on Application Security Lead with at least 5 years of experience across mobile, API and web application security and DevSecOps. You will test client applications, find the issues that matter and help engineering teams build security into their CI/CD pipelines.

You will work with banks, fintechs, payment companies, SaaS and enterprise product teams, own engagements from scoping to retest and be the technical point of contact for client developers and security leads.

What you will do

Mobile application security

• Static, dynamic and manual testing of Android and iOS apps against OWASP MASVS and MASTG.

• Test root and jailbreak detection, certificate pinning, secure storage, device binding, RASP and anti-tampering using Frida, Objection and similar tools.

API security

• Test REST, GraphQL and SOAP APIs against the OWASP API Security Top 10.

• Find broken object and function level authorisation, mass assignment, rate limiting gaps and business logic flaws.

• Review OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and JWT implementations.

Web application security

• Manual and automated web application penetration testing against the OWASP Top 10 and OWASP WSTG.

• Test authentication, session management, access control, injection, SSRF, deserialisation and client-side issues.

DevSecOps

• Integrate SAST, SCA, DAST, secrets, container and IaC scanning into CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, Jenkins).

• Define security gates, triage workflows and vulnerability SLAs with engineering teams.

• Review Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform configurations for misconfigurations.

• Run threat modelling sessions (STRIDE or similar) for new features and architectures.

Delivery and leadership

• Write clear reports with risk ratings, proof of concept and practical fixes, then retest and confirm closure.

• Run secure development awareness sessions for client developers.

• Mentor junior testers and quality-check findings before they reach clients.

What you bring

• 5+ years of hands-on application security experience.

• Proven work across mobile, API, web and DevSecOps.

• Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, MASVS, MASTG, ASVS, CWE and CVSS.

• Has set up or improved security tooling in a CI/CD pipeline.

• Scripting in Python, Bash or similar to automate testing.

• Clear communicator who can explain findings to developers and to senior management.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or equivalent experience.

Tools you will use

• Mobile: MobSF, Frida, Objection, Jadx, apktool, Ghidra, Drozer, adb

• API: Burp Suite Pro, Postman, OWASP ZAP, GraphQL tooling

• Web: Burp Suite Pro and extensions, sqlmap, ffuf, Nuclei

• DevSecOps: Semgrep, SonarQube, Snyk, Trivy, Checkov, Gitleaks, Docker, Kubernetes

• Cloud: security review of apps on AWS, Azure or GCP

Good to have

• Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, eMAPT, GMOB, GWAPT, Burp Suite Certified Practitioner or Certified DevSecOps Professional (CDP).

• CVEs, bug bounty findings or open-source security tools.

• Experience with BFSI or payment apps (UPI, cards, wallets) and RBI, NPCI or CERT-In security testing requirements.

Why HTS Consulting

• Varied mobile, API, web and DevSecOps projects for banks, fintechs, SaaS and enterprise clients.

• Sponsored certifications (OSCP, OSWE, CDP or similar) and a training budget.

• A clear growth path to Principal Consultant or Practice Lead.

• Salary band will be discussed at the time of interview.

How to apply

Apply through LinkedIn or share your profile with ashok@hts.consulting with the subject "Application Security Lead – <Your Name>".

description:
Penetration Tester – AI Security & Application SecurityRole Overview

We are seeking a skilled Penetration Tester with strong expertise in Application Security and emerging AI Security testing. The role involves conducting comprehensive security assessments across web, mobile, API, cloud, and AI-powered applications, identifying vulnerabilities, and providing actionable remediation guidance.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform penetration testing of web applications, mobile applications, APIs, thick-client applications, cloud-native environments, and network infrastructure using both manual and automated techniques.
* Conduct security assessments of AI/GenAI-powered solutions, including AI chatbots, AI agents, LLM-based applications, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations.
* Execute AI security test cases covering prompt injection, jailbreak attacks, sensitive data exposure, harmful content generation, tool misuse, hallucinations, grounding failures, excessive agent privileges, and policy bypass scenarios.
* Design and execute adversarial testing techniques to evaluate the effectiveness of AI models, guardrails, and security controls.
* Identify, validate, and prioritize security vulnerabilities based on severity, exploitability, and business impact.
* Prepare detailed assessment reports including findings, risk ratings, supporting evidence, proof-of-concept demonstrations, and remediation recommendations.
* Collaborate with development, security, and project teams to validate vulnerabilities, communicate risks, and support remediation efforts.
* Stay updated on evolving cybersecurity threats, AI security risks, attack vectors, and penetration testing methodologies.
* Contribute to security testing standards, methodologies, templates, reporting frameworks, and process improvements.

Required Skills & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience in Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT).
* Strong expertise in OWASP Top 10 (Web, API, LLM Security), Agentic AI Security, MCP security, SANS Top 25, PTES, OSSTMM, and NIST frameworks.
* Minimum 2+ years of practical experience assessing GenAI and LLM security risks, including prompt injection, model manipulation, data leakage, insecure outputs, hallucinations, and model abuse scenarios.
* Experience developing and executing structured AI security testing methodologies and test cases.
* Hands-on experience with security assessment tools such as Burp Suite and HCL AppScan.
* Good understanding of SAST, DAST, and modern application security testing practices.
* Strong knowledge of application architecture, secure coding practices, SDLC, authentication mechanisms, cryptography, and security protocols.
* Relevant security certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, CEH, or equivalent are preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Preferred Competencies

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to independently manage security assessments and meet project timelines.
* Experience working with cross-functional and globally distributed teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills.
* Ability to clearly document testing scope, assumptions, limitations, evidence, and security recommendations.

Engagement Expectations

* Deliver high-quality security assessment outcomes within agreed timelines.
* Collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders throughout the engagement lifecycle.
* Support occasional coordination across global time zones when required.
* Maintain thorough documentation of testing activities, findings, and recommendations.
* Demonstrate a proactive, self-driven approach to delivering security testing engagements.

As a SOC Engineer, you will be the main technical support for our L2/L3 analysts. You will handle threat hunting, vulnerability management, patch management, and compliance tasks, and help make our detection and response stronger. This role needs you to work at night and on rotational shifts.

**W**
**hat will you do?**

* Monitor, triage, and investigate security alerts from SIEM, EDR, firewall, and cloud tools
* Support L2/L3 analysts in incident investigation, containment, and remediation
* Perform proactive threat hunting using threat intel, IOCs, and MITRE ATT&CK
* Run vulnerability scans, rank findings by risk, and track fixes with IT and engineering teams
* Manage patch management across Windows, macOS, and Linux systems, and track patch compliance
* Create, tune, and test detection rules to reduce false positives
* Follow SOC processes and SOPs for alert triage, escalation, and incident handling
* Meet defined SLAs for alert response, investigation, and incident closure
* Track SLA breaches and help improve response times
* Create, review, and update SOC SOPs, processes, and escalation matrix
* Investigate phishing emails, suspicious logins, and malware alerts
* Analyze logs from firewalls, endpoints, identity platforms, and SaaS applications
* Write and update SOC runbooks, playbooks, and incident reports
* Help build and improve SOC automation workflows
* Guide and support L1 analysts on triage and escalation
* Support compliance and audit activities: collect evidence, map controls, and prepare reports
* Make sure SOC processes follow company security policies and compliance requirements
* Share clear shift handover notes with the team

**Who are we looking for?**

* 2 to 4 years of experience in a SOC or security operations role
* Willing to work in night shifts and rotational shifts, including weekends when needed
* Good networking knowledge: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewalls, routing, ports, and protocols
* Strong security basics: common attack types, malware, phishing, lateral movement, privilege escalation
* Hands-on experience in threat hunting and incident response
* Hands-on experience in vulnerability management and vulnerability scanning tools
* Hands-on experience in patch management for Windows, macOS, and Linux
* Experience working with SIEM and EDR tools
* Good knowledge of security compliance frameworks like ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, and India's DPDP Act
* Experience supporting internal or external security audits
* Good knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and the incident response lifecycle
* Basic knowledge of cloud, identity, and endpoint security
* Basic scripting in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for log analysis and automation
* Good written and verbal communication; able to write clear incident and audit reports
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field

**Working at Origin Medical Research Lab**

You will receive competitive monthly compensation aligned with industry standards. Additionally, we provide a comprehensive benefits package, including: 

* Provident fund
* Paid annual leaves
* Sick leaves
* Wellness allowance
* Insurance allowance

You will work with an exceptional team of highly qualified individuals who strive towards a common goal of delivering a product that improves the standard of care for expecting mothers everywhere.

You will also collaborate with renowned clinicians, AI scientists, and business leaders from around the world. 

At Origin Medical Research Lab, we take pride in fostering an inclusive and optimistic company culture that places great value on collaboration, teamwork, and work-life balance. As a valued member of our team, you will have the opportunity to join a supportive environment where individuals genuinely care about each other's success and well-being. **Skills And Attributes For Success**

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

title: Performance Test Architect
description:
Performance Testing Architect

Location - Bangalore

Required Qualifications

10+ years in software QA/testing with at least 5 years focused exclusively on Non-Functional Testing (performance, load, stress, security) for enterprise-grade web applications.

Proven track record of architecting and driving NFT programs end-to-end — from customer NFR workshops through tooling setup, test execution, and executive-level reporting.

Hands-on proficiency with performance/load testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, Locust, or k6, and security testing tools such as OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, Nessus, or Qualys.

Solid working knowledge of Azure cloud infrastructure (App Services, Azure Load Testing, Azure Monitor, Application Insights) and its impact on application performance and security posture.

Experience with APM and observability platforms (Dynatrace, Datadog, or New Relic) for performance profiling, bottleneck isolation, and capacity planning.

Strong communication and consulting skills — ability to run NFR definition sessions with customers, present risk-rated findings to non-technical stakeholders, and align cross-functional teams on quality gates.

Tech Stack

· JMeterLocustGatlingk6OWASP ZAPBurp SuiteNessus / QualysAzure DevOpsAzure Load TestingApplication InsightsDatadogDynatracePlaywrightPythonDocker / Kubernetes

Preferred Qualifications

Certifications in performance testing (ISTQB Performance Testing Specialist) or security testing (CEH, OSCP, or relevant Azure security certifications).

Experience with UI/UX performance measurement tools (Google Lighthouse, WebPageTest, Core Web Vitals) for page responsiveness and load-time optimization on B2B portals.

Prior experience in an IT services or consulting environment — managing NFT deliverables, customer expectations, and multi-stakeholder engagements simultaneously.

Familiarity with DevSecOps practices and shift-left security integration within Azure-based CI/CD workflows.

Exposure to accessibility testing standards (WCAG 2.1) relevant to enterprise B2B web applications.

Roles & Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Define and own the end-to-end Non-Functional Testing strategy and framework covering performance, load, stress, UI/UX responsiveness, and security vulnerability testing for an Azure-hosted B2B web application.

Lead customer-facing NFR requirement workshops — translate business expectations into measurable test criteria, SLA thresholds, and acceptance gates in collaboration with product and engineering stakeholders.

Evaluate, select, and onboard the NFT tooling stack; establish standards for load simulation, vulnerability scanning, and frontend performance profiling suited to the Azure platform.

Design realistic workload models, test scenarios, and data strategies for load and stress testing that reflect B2B usage patterns, peak traffic, and failure conditions.

Plan and execute security vulnerability assessments (VAPT) aligned to OWASP Top 10; coordinate with DevSecOps teams to log, prioritize, and track remediation of findings.

Integrate NFT suites into Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, establishing automated performance gates and regression baselines that block releases when thresholds are breached.

Monitor application performance using APM tools (Dynatrace, Datadog, or Application Insights); analyse bottlenecks and provide root-cause analysis with actionable optimization recommendations.

Lead, mentor, and grow a team of QA engineers — providing technical direction, script/code reviews, and hands-on guidance during test execution, triage, and reporting to both technical and business audiences

* Knowledge of NIST SP 800-53, CIS Controls and Benchmarks, ISO/IEC 27001, zero trust principles, and risk-based control design.
* Ability to interpret cloud-provider documentation and convert complex technical content into concise, testable, and auditable requirements.
* Strong technical writing, analysis, organization, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple assigned deliverables, incorporate review feedback, and maintain accurate status reporting in an Agile delivery environment.

* Cloud or security certification such as CCSP, CISSP, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer.

* Experience with infrastructure as code or policy as code using Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, ARM templates, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with regulated financial services or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience supporting audit or regulatory examinations and producing audit-defensible evidence packages.
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, or comparable tools used to manage requirements, evidence, reviews, approvals, and delivery status.

**Expected Deliverables**

* New or revised cloud STIGs and supporting control documentation that meet SLG quality and governance requirements.
* Documented cleanup recommendations and completed remediation of assigned STIG content.
* Accurate control mappings, assessment procedures, implementation guidance, and evidence requirements.
* Complete evidence packages and validation summaries for controls without automated CaC coverage.
* Documented review comments, issue dispositions, stakeholder decisions, approvals, exceptions, and open dependencies.
* Regular delivery-status reporting, including completed work, work in progress, blockers, and risks requiring escalation.

**Engagement Success Criteria**

* Assigned STIG deliverables are technically accurate, internally consistent, testable, traceable, and completed in accordance with agreed priorities and review cycles.
* Evidence packages clearly demonstrate whether the applicable requirement has been implemented and contain sufficient documentation to support review and audit activities.
* Manual validation is performed consistently where CaC is unavailable, with conclusions linked to the requirement, assessment method, evidence reviewed, and accountable approver.
* Issues and dependencies are identified early, documented clearly, and escalated through the designated SLG governance process.
* Work products are maintained in the approved repositories and can be understood and reused by TD personnel after the engagement ends.

title: Lead Security Reliability Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
In this opportunity as Lead Security Reliability Engineer, you will:
  
  

* Act as the technical lead for security across application, cloud, and infrastructure. Set technical direction, make the key calls, own the shape and quality of the security backlog end to end, and serve as the point of escalation for complex security and remediation work, without direct line-management responsibility.
* Design and build security controls across layers such as operating systems, container orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, cloud configuration, and network boundaries, to defend against sophisticated adversaries and insider threats.
* Design new security processes and ways of working, revamping patching cycles and golden-image and base-image refreshes across cloud and on-prem, so the team can move fast without sacrificing safety.
* Come to the table with ideas: identify where security and remediation processes can be improved, propose better approaches, and turn them into standards the team adopts.
* Set the technical approach across the full security scope: application and open-source dependency fixes, infrastructure patching, cloud configuration and guardrails, WAF, network isolation, and secrets and machine-identity management. Prioritize by risk in line with industry best practice such as CISA guidance (CISA KEV, CVSS/EPSS, and SLA-driven burndown), and champion adoption of AI-augmented security tooling, including SAST and SCA.
* Raise the technical bar by reviewing fixes and mentoring engineers, and coordinate with the wider security team across regions to keep standards and priorities aligned across time zones.
* Own clear reporting and metrics, and build the runbooks, standards, and escalation paths that make security a repeatable, auditable capability.

**About You**
You're a fit for the role of Lead Security Reliability Engineer if your background includes:
  
  

* 8+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, vulnerability management, or cloud and infrastructure security, including time as a technical lead or senior individual contributor setting direction and guiding the technical work of other engineers, plus a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* A deep understanding of security principles, common vulnerabilities, and best practice across application, cloud, and infrastructure layers.
* A working command of vulnerability management at scale: prioritization frameworks, CVSS/EPSS, CISA KEV, and SLA-driven burndown.

* Strong judgment on balancing risk reduction against operational and customer impact.

title: Secure development & assurance lead (CE100SF RM 4552)
description:
**Position: Secure development & assurance lead (CE100SF RM 4552)**
**Secure Development And Assurance Lead**

* You will lead the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) program by translating Threat and Risk Assessment (TRA) outputs into actionable engineering work, ensuring cybersecurity requirements and risk mitigation activities are planned, executed, and tracked throughout the product development lifecycle.
* You will oversee cybersecurity engineering and assurance activities, including security code reviews, Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), Software Composition Analysis (SCA), vulnerability scanning, penetration testing coordination, security validation, and compliance testing to provide objective evidence that cybersecurity requirements have been implemented and verified.
* You will manage the cybersecurity remediation backlog by tracking vulnerabilities identified throughout development, coordinating remediation activities with engineering teams, and ensuring all findings are appropriately prioritized, resolved, or formally dispositioned using risk-based decision-making principles while maintaining traceability to the originating Threat and Risk Assessment (TRA).
* You will own the quality, traceability, and audit readiness of Secure SDLC deliverables, including security assessment reports, compliance reports, Product Development Environment Security Asset Lists, Product Security Supplier Reports, Security Vulnerability Monitoring (SVM) registrations, and the Product Security Cybersecurity Release Readiness Report (PSCRR).
* You will partner with software engineering, verification, cybersecurity architecture, quality, regulatory, and product management teams to ensure cybersecurity assurance activities are executed consistently, objective evidence is complete, and security-related development activities align with regulatory, organizational, and product release expectations.
* You will collaborate with peers to continuously improve Secure SDLC processes, cybersecurity engineering methodologies, security automation, vulnerability management workflows, security assurance practices, and developer enablement across product development organizations.

**Your Expertise**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience. Minimum 10+ years of experience in software engineering, application security, product cybersecurity, secure software development, or software assurance, including 3+ years leading technical teams or cybersecurity initiatives.
* Demonstrated expertise in Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) practices, secure software engineering, application security, Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), Software Composition Analysis (SCA), vulnerability management, penetration testing, security validation, and cybersecurity assurance methodologies for complex software-enabled products.
* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity risk management, secure development practices, security verification, vulnerability assessment, remediation management, security control implementation, software assurance, and risk-based engineering decision making, with the ability to translate cybersecurity findings into practical engineering actions.
* Experience supporting regulated product development, including security assessment execution, vulnerability disposition, remediation tracking, cybersecurity traceability, compliance testing, objective cybersecurity evidence, Product Security Cybersecurity Release Readiness Reports (PSCRR), and cybersecurity deliverables supporting regulatory submissions and customer cybersecurity communications.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional cybersecurity engineering activities across software development, verification, cybersecurity architecture, quality, and regulatory organizations while maintaining objective evidence supporting cybersecurity compliance, product release readiness, and software assurance.
* Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with a track record of mentoring technical teams, fostering collaboration, and contributing to the continuous improvement of Secure SDLC practices, cybersecurity engineering processes, security automation, vulnerability management, and software assurance methodologies. Experience in medical devices, laboratory diagnostics, or other regulated industries is highly desirable. Willingness to travel up to 25% as business needs require

Reporting to the Product Owner for Product Risk Assessment, this role will provide the engine of the AppHealth function. Working collaboratively with the LSEG Application Owner population, this role will:
  
  
**Technical:**
Apply the AppHealth tooling and detection techniques. Support policy enforcement and response plans using insights provided by AppHealth. Understand root causes, challenge assumptions, and assist Application Owners by correct selection of secure design, secure pattern design and security architecture reviews.
  
  
**Customer Focus:**
I consider customer needs in my work, contribute ideas to improve our product, respond quickly to operational issues that affect or risk affecting customers, and seek feedback with other Cyber and Tech Risk groups to improve how we work.
  
  
**Risk Management:**
I conduct the Product Risk Assessment reviews which form the core of the role. I drive Product Risk Assessment reviews and evidence assessments. I implement incremental improvements and use the data provided by Product Risk Assessments to contribute to visibility of controls.
  
  
**Leadership:**
Take accountability for delivering reliable work. I support and coach peers and share knowledge openly. I contribute to team outcomes by collaborating effectively and helping others succeed through trust and shared ownership.
  
  
**Analytical:**
I apply structured thinking and data to review the responses to Product Risk Assessment responses, solve problems identified as part of the Product Risk Assessment activity, test assumptions, and learn from outcomes. I support team decisions through evidence, insight, and continuous improvement. Work with the AppHealth Product Owner to establish and systemise reporting on AppHealth’s results and outcome to the broad stakeholder groups within LSEG.
  
  
**Adaptability:**
I continuously learn and adapt to new priorities, try different approaches, and share what works with my team. I make learning my craft a regular habit, not just something I pick up through daily work.
  
  
**Communication:**
I contribute to team discussions and communicate clearly with peers. I share context, ask questions and help the team align around shared work.
  
  
The AppHealth initiative is currently in the early stages of operation after successful trials, with a defined future demand and enhancement runway and developing target operating model.
