title: Infrastructure Engineer III
description:
**Job Description**
The Infrastructure Patching & Security Engineering team ensures the security, stability, compliance, and operational resilience of enterprise infrastructure platforms through proactive patch management, vulnerability remediation, security hardening, automation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The team is responsible for maintaining secure and compliant Red Hat Linux, Windows environments by implementing enterprise patching strategies, addressing security vulnerabilities, reducing infrastructure risk, and ensuring adherence to organizational security standards.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Infrastructure Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Windows Server, VMware, system administration, OS patching, vulnerability management, infrastructure security, automation, and scripting. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing enterprise-wide patching operations, remediating security vulnerabilities, troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, and driving automation to improve patch compliance and operational efficiency.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**OS Patching & Infrastructure Security Operations**

* Plan, coordinate, execute, and manage enterprise-wide operating system patching across Red Hat Linux and Windows infrastructure.
* Own end-to-end patch management activities, including patch assessment, planning, testing, deployment, validation, reporting, and remediation.
* Manage monthly, emergency, and out-of-band security patching cycles across production and non-production environments.
* Implement security patches, critical updates, kernel upgrades, and operating system fixes in accordance with enterprise security policies.
* Identify and remediate missing patches, outdated software packages, and infrastructure security vulnerabilities.
* Troubleshoot patch installation failures, dependency conflicts, repository issues, reboot failures, and post-patching system issues.
* Ensure patching activities are executed within approved maintenance windows with minimal business disruption.
* Develop patch rollback, recovery, and contingency procedures to minimize operational risks.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, application, cybersecurity, and change management teams to ensure timely patch deployment and compliance.

**Red Hat Linux, Windows & VMware Administration**

* Build, configure, administer, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise Red Hat Enterprise Linux and Windows Server environments.
* Perform Linux patching using YUM, DNF, RPM, Red Hat Satellite, and related patch management tools.
* Manage Windows Server patching using Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), WSUS, or equivalent enterprise patching platforms.
* Support VMware ESXi and vCenter patching, upgrades, lifecycle management, and security remediation.
* Troubleshoot Linux kernel issues, package dependencies, system services, boot failures, filesystem issues, and OS performance degradation.
* Administer Windows Server infrastructure, including Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Windows Update services.
* Perform server health checks, pre-patching readiness assessments, and post-patching validation.
* Support operating system upgrades, end-of-life remediation, server migrations, and infrastructure modernization.

**Vulnerability Management & Security Remediation**

* Partner with cybersecurity and vulnerability management teams to identify, assess, prioritize, and remediate infrastructure vulnerabilities.
* Analyze vulnerability scan results from tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or equivalent enterprise security platforms.
* Remediate critical and high-severity vulnerabilities within defined security SLAs.
* Investigate vulnerabilities associated with operating systems, software packages, system configurations, and infrastructure components.
* Implement security hardening recommendations based on CIS benchmarks, vendor guidance, and enterprise security standards.
* Address security findings related to outdated packages, insecure protocols, weak configurations, unsupported operating systems, and missing security patches.
* Support vulnerability exception management, risk acceptance processes, and remediation tracking.
* Coordinate with application owners and infrastructure teams to resolve vulnerabilities requiring application compatibility testing or planned downtime.
* Maintain accurate vulnerability remediation records, compliance evidence, and audit documentation.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce vulnerability exposure and infrastructure security risk.

**Patching Automation & Scripting**

* Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions for enterprise infrastructure patching and security remediation.
* Automate Linux and Windows patch deployment, patch validation, compliance checks, and operational reporting.
* Develop automation scripts using Python, Bash, PowerShell, and Ansible.
* Implement Ansible playbooks for Linux patching, server configuration, security hardening, and vulnerability remediation.
* Automate patch readiness checks, server reboot coordination, service validation, and post-patching health checks.
* Integrate patching workflows with enterprise automation, orchestration, and IT service management platforms.
* Develop reusable scripts and automation frameworks to reduce manual intervention and improve patching consistency.
* Troubleshoot automation failures and continuously optimize patch deployment workflows.
* Identify opportunities to improve patch success rates, reduce patching cycle times, and increase infrastructure compliance through automation.

**Patch Compliance, Governance & Reporting**

* Track and maintain infrastructure patch compliance across Linux, Windows, and VMware platforms.
* Monitor patch deployment status, remediation progress, patch failures, and outstanding security vulnerabilities.
* Generate patch compliance dashboards, vulnerability remediation reports, and operational metrics.
* Ensure infrastructure patching activities align with enterprise security policies, regulatory requirements, and internal audit standards.
* Support security audits by providing patching evidence, remediation documentation, and compliance reports.
* Identify systems that are non-compliant, unsupported, or approaching end of life and develop remediation plans.
* Manage patching exceptions, risk assessments, and remediation timelines in coordination with cybersecurity and risk teams.
* Drive improvements in patch coverage, patch success rates, vulnerability remediation SLAs, and overall security posture.

**Infrastructure Support & Incident Management**

* Provide advanced L2/L3 technical support for Linux, Windows, VMware, and infrastructure patching platforms.
* Troubleshoot complex operating system, patching, application compatibility, performance, and availability issues.
* Participate in major incident management, root cause analysis (RCA), and problem management activities.
* Investigate infrastructure incidents caused by failed patches, operating system updates, configuration changes, or security remediation.
* Coordinate with application, database, network, storage, security, and infrastructure engineering teams to resolve cross-platform issues.
* Perform proactive infrastructure health checks, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* Support production change implementation, maintenance activities, and emergency security patch deployments.
* Develop and maintain operational runbooks, patching procedures, troubleshooting guides, and technical documentation.
* Participate in on-call support and scheduled maintenance activities to ensure critical infrastructure availability.

**Qualifications**
**Required Experience & Technical Skills**

* 10 years of overall IT infrastructure, system administration, patch management, or infrastructure security engineering experience.
* Strong hands-on experience managing enterprise-wide operating system patching and vulnerability remediation across large-scale infrastructure environments.
* Extensive expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL 7/8/9 or later), including administration, patching, kernel upgrades, troubleshooting, and security hardening.
* Strong hands-on experience with Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 or later, including administration, security updates, patch deployment, and troubleshooting.
* Strong experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, virtualization management, patching, and lifecycle operations.
* Hands-on experience with Linux patch management tools such as Red Hat Satellite, YUM, DNF, and RPM.
* Experience with Windows patch management platforms such as SCCM/MECM, WSUS, or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Strong understanding of vulnerability management processes and remediation using tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management using Ansible.
* Hands-on scripting experience using Python, Bash/Shell scripting, and PowerShell.
* Strong understanding of operating system security hardening, CIS benchmarks, vulnerability remediation, and patch compliance.
* Experience managing critical and high-severity security vulnerabilities and meeting defined remediation SLAs.
* Good understanding of enterprise networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of enterprise storage technologies, filesystems, and infrastructure performance management.
* Experience with patching governance, change management, incident management, and ITIL processes.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across operating systems, infrastructure security, patching platforms, VMware, networking, and storage.
* Experience supporting large-scale production infrastructure in highly regulated environments.
* Strong communication, documentation, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE).
* Microsoft Windows Server or infrastructure certification.
* Red Hat Ansible Automation certification.
* Experience with Red Hat Satellite, Ansible Automation Platform, Microsoft Configuration Manager, and enterprise patch orchestration solutions.
* Familiarity with ServiceNow, CMDB, change management, and automated patch compliance reporting.
* Knowledge of CIS benchmarks, NIST security frameworks, and enterprise security compliance requirements.
* Experience implementing automated vulnerability remediation and infrastructure security controls.

**Position Summary**

You will work alongside senior practitioners and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality outcomes, leveraging both traditional VM tooling and emerging Anthropic / Agentic AI capabilities to accelerate threat detection and response.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for leading vulnerability management engagements across client environments.
  
  

* Lead vulnerability assessment engagements across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments, and manage the vulnerability management lifecycle from policy design through remediation verification.

* Integrate vulnerability management platforms with security orchestration, security information and event management, and information technology service management systems to automate workflows and reduce manual effort.
* Define and improve operating procedures, service level agreements, and quality metrics; mentor junior team members; and coordinate remediation tracking across stakeholder groups.

Cyber Operate teams manage clients' critical cyber assets either as a fully managed service or in partnership with clients. They deliver skilled talent, cutting-edge technologies, and robust processes to operate client cyber capabilities. This includes managing the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security, business transformation, and ensuring continuous compliance. Services include Cyber-as-a-Service, Managed Application Security, and Managed Extended Detect & Respond (MXDR).

title: Engineering Manager - Infrastructure Security
description:
**About the team**

The Platform & Infrastructure Engineering team owns the foundational estate that everything else runs on. The team designs, builds, automates, and operates scalable cloud-native systems across networks, security, data & storage, and compute. It carries significant regulatory and operational responsibility, with its platforms directly underpinning critical customer-facing systems such as payments and banking, so security and availability are not optional.

**About the role**

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Infrastructure Security at slice. You will own charters like cloud security, network security, and software supply chain security and build a team that makes the secure path the default path for every engineer. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the architecture, hire and grow the team, and be accountable for measurable, auditable security outcomes across our cloud and hybrid estate.

**What You will do**

* Lead, hire and scale the Infrastructure Security team, setting goals, mentoring engineers, and developing technical leaders.
* Own the cloud and hybrid network security architecture and roadmap, balancing security, reliability, scalability, velocity and cost.
* Establish secure-by-design principles, guardrails and baseline configurations across AWS accounts, organizations and future cloud regions.
* Drive Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and platform automation to ensure security controls are version-controlled, tested, repeatable and consistently enforced.
* Own IAM, SSO/Identity Center, PAM, least-privilege access, just-in-time access and secrets management.
* Enforce encryption, KMS/HSM key management, certificate lifecycle management and data protection standards.
* Secure Kubernetes (EKS), compute workloads and container images through hardening, runtime protection and automated patching.
* Design secure network architecture, including VPC segmentation, hybrid connectivity, egress controls, firewalls, DNS security, IDS/IPS, and zero-trust access.
* Protect internet-facing services and APIs using DDoS mitigation, WAF, bot management, rate limiting, and API security controls.
* Harden CI/CD pipelines and implement DevSecOps practices, including short-lived credentials (OIDC), SCA, image scanning, SBOMs, artifact signing and provenance.
* Implement policy-as-code and admission controls to prevent misconfigured infrastructure and untrusted or vulnerable artifacts from reaching production.
* Govern open-source and third-party dependencies through vulnerability management, license compliance, and remediation of SLAs.
* Establish security metrics for control coverage, policy violations, exposure and remediation timelines; continuously detect and remediate misconfigurations and security drifts.
* Partner with Cybersecurity, AppSec, GRC and SOC teams to address security and compliance gaps and support audits.
* Lead infrastructure security incident responses, including DDoS attacks and cloud misconfigurations, and drive blameless post-incident reviews.
* Strengthen resilience through availability planning, disaster recovery, capacity management, incident readiness, and recovery exercises for critical infrastructure.

**What You will need**

* 9+ years in infrastructure, cloud or security engineering, including 2+ years managing and building high-performing teams.
* Deep hands-on expertise in AWS/GCP/Azure security (IAM, Organizations/SCPs, KMS, Security Hub, Guard Duty or equivalents) and cloud security architecture.
* Strong understanding of IAM, SSO, PAM, secrets management, encryption and key management.
* Deep expertise in cloud and data-center networking, hybrid connectivity, firewalls, WAF, DDoS protection and IDS/IPS.
* Practical experience with CI/CD hardening, SCA and image scanning, SBOMs, artifact signing and policy enforcement.
* Strong infrastructure-as-code skills (e.g., Terraform) and experience building guardrails at scale.
* Solid grounding in observability, incident management, disaster recovery, and capacity planning.
* Strong understanding of Linux, networking, and distributed systems.
* Experience designing infrastructure for high-scale, highly available environments.
* Experience in fintech, banking, or another highly regulated industry.
* Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid-cloud environments.
* Experience with RBI cyber security and IT governance directions, CERT-In guidelines, PCI DSS or NPCI audits.
* Depth in admission controllers, policy engines and runtime security tools.
* Certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, CCSP, CISSP or CKS.
* Contributions to security tooling, open source or the wider security community.

**Life at slice**

Life so good, you’d think we’re kidding:

* Competitive salaries. Period.
* An extensive medical insurance that looks out for our employees & their dependants. We’ll love you and take care of you, our promise.
* Flexible working hours. Just don’t call us at 3AM, we like our sleep schedule.
* Tailored vacation & leave policies so that you enjoy every important moment in your life.
* A reward system that celebrates hard work and milestones throughout the year. Expect a gift coming your way anytime you kill it here.
* Learning and upskilling opportunities. Seriously, not kidding.
* Good food, games, and a cool office to make you feel like home. An environment so good, you’ll forget the term “colleagues can’t be your friends”.

title: Senior System Engineer
description:

title: Linux Test Engineer
description:

description:

****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. **Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
****Job Summary****
We are seeking a skilled
**Senior Analyst – Threat & Vulnerability Management**
to join
**Infrastructure Services -CAT IT Division**
The
**Senior Vulnerability Management Analyst**
is responsible for leading the identification, prioritization, tracking, and remediation governance of critical security vulnerabilities across the enterprise. This role serves as a key liaison between cybersecurity, infrastructure, application, and business teams to ensure vulnerabilities are remediated within established SLAs and organizational risk thresholds.
  
  
The Senior Analyst will leverage
**ServiceNow Vulnerability Response**
, security scanning platforms, and advanced reporting capabilities to drive accountability, improve remediation performance, identify systemic risks, and provide executive-level visibility into the organization's security posture. The role requires strong analytical, stakeholder management, and leadership communication skills, along with the ability to influence remediation outcomes across multiple technology teams.
  
  
The preference for this role is to be based out of
**Whitefield PSN Office , Bangalore -KA**
****What You Will Do****
**Vulnerability Management & Remediation Governance**

* Lead the end-to-end management of critical and high-risk vulnerabilities, ensuring remediation activities align with organizational SLAs and security policies.
* Monitor and analyze vulnerability data from ServiceNow Vulnerability Response and vulnerability scanning platforms to identify aged, recurring, and high-impact security risks.
* Validate vulnerability records, asset ownership mappings, assignment groups, risk scores, and remediation status.
* Drive accountability by assigning, tracking, and escalating remediation activities across infrastructure, cloud, network, application, and endpoint teams.
* Evaluate remediation plans, compensating controls, and exception requests to ensure appropriate risk treatment decisions.
* Support vulnerability prioritization using CVSS scores, exploitability, threat intelligence, business criticality, and asset context.

**ServiceNow Administration & Process Optimization**

* Act as a subject matter expert for ServiceNow Vulnerability Response workflows and reporting.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, workflows, reports, and KPIs to improve vulnerability management effectiveness.
* Identify process inefficiencies and recommend automation opportunities to enhance tracking, reporting, and remediation activities.
* Partner with platform teams to improve vulnerability response processes and governance controls.

**Stakeholder Management & Collaboration**

* Engage directly with technical teams, application owners, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to obtain remediation commitments and timelines.
* Facilitate remediation discussions, risk reviews, and vulnerability governance meetings.
* Provide guidance to stakeholders on vulnerability remediation best practices and prioritization strategies.
* Escalate SLA breaches, chronic offenders, and unresolved critical vulnerabilities to leadership and risk governance forums.
* Mentor junior analysts and provide guidance on vulnerability management processes and cybersecurity best practices.

**Data Analytics & Risk Reporting**

* Perform advanced analysis of vulnerability trends, remediation performance, recurring findings, and ownership gaps.
* Develop metrics and reporting related to:

+ SLA compliance
+ Vulnerability aging
+ Risk exposure trends
+ Remediation effectiveness
+ Business unit performance
+ Executive risk posture

* Create and maintain dashboards using ServiceNow, Excel, Power BI, or similar reporting tools.
* Identify systemic issues and strategic improvement opportunities across security and IT operations.

**Executive Communication & Leadership Reporting**

* Prepare executive-ready dashboards, scorecards, and presentations for cybersecurity and technology leadership.
* Present vulnerability trends, key risks, remediation progress, and strategic recommendations during governance and leadership reviews.
* Provide risk-based insights and recommendations to support decision-making and security investment priorities.
* Communicate complex technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

****What You Will Have****

* 10–12 years of overall IT and Cybersecurity experience, with at least 5+ years focused on Vulnerability Management, Security Operations, Risk Management, or Cyber Defense functions.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow Vulnerability Response and/or ITSM platforms.
* Strong understanding of vulnerability management lifecycle, risk assessment methodologies, and remediation workflows.
* Experience working with enterprise vulnerability scanning tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, Wiz, or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management.
* Strong knowledge of:

+ CVSS scoring
+ Common vulnerabilities and exposures (CVEs)
+ Asset criticality
+ Patch management
+ Risk and exception management

* Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and PowerPoint.
* Experience interacting with senior leadership and presenting cybersecurity metrics and risk posture updates.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or related field.
* Industry certifications such as:

+ CISSP
+ CISM
+ GSEC
+ Security+
+ CRISC
+ GIAC Vulnerability Management certifications

* Experience with cloud security platforms and cloud-native vulnerability management.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and standards including:

+ NIST Cybersecurity Framework
+ CIS Controls
+ ISO 27001
+ PCI DSS

* Experience leading vulnerability governance programs in large enterprise environments.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic Risk Management
* Vulnerability Assessment & Prioritization
* Executive Stakeholder Management
* Cybersecurity Governance
* Data Analytics & Reporting
* ServiceNow Vulnerability Response
* Process Improvement & Automation
* Leadership Communication
* Cross-functional Collaboration
* Mentoring & Team Development

**Success Measures**

* Reduction in overdue critical and high-risk vulnerabilities.
* Improvement in remediation SLA compliance across business units.
* Increased visibility and accountability through executive reporting.
* Identification and remediation of systemic vulnerability management gaps.
* Enhanced stakeholder engagement and risk governance effectiveness.

****Skills Desired:****
**Core Application Systems**
: Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Manages application-related issues, implications, and approaches with clients.
* Evaluates key interfaces and interdependencies among core applications systems.
* Explains features and benefits of core applications for consideration by business units.
* Implements existing and planned application enhancements in major business units.

title: Cyber Security Architect
description:

  **Azure**

title: AI Researcher: Adversarial Systems
description:
**Everyone else here builds the system. This role exists to prove it's wrong.**

You'd be measured on how much damage you do to our own work.

**Why this work**

India has been caught by surprise before. Not because the warning didn't exist, but because it existed somewhere in the system and nobody put it together in time. People died because of that gap. We're closing it.

We're building the intelligence system that helps India see the next attack coming before it happens, and helps it win the next war before the first shot is fired. Not with better sensors; India already collects enough. With the ability to actually use what it collects, at the speed the threat moves.

This doesn't get built by a foreign company, and it doesn't get built for a demo. It gets built by people who decided this mattered enough to build it here, for real, before it's needed. If we do this right, the payoff is a warning that gets acted on in time, and a war that's already won in preparation before it's fought at all.

**What that means for this role**

The characteristic failure of an agentic reasoning system is output that's fluent, well-cited, internally coherent, and wrong. It's hardest to catch exactly where it matters most, and it gets more persuasive as the models improve. In consumer software that's a bad quarter. Here it lands on people who had no say in it.

The institutions we work with are deeply sceptical of automated judgment, and they're right to be. The only real answer is a dedicated adversarial function, independent of the teams it evaluates. A critic sharing context with its target inherits the target's blind spots. It's the highest-value thing we'll build and the easiest to quietly cut. We're putting it in the job post so you can hold us to it.

If you think AI in defence should be built carefully or not at all, this is the role that makes carefully possible, and keeps it honest.

**A note on the obvious pitch**

The tempting framing is self-play: agents run ten thousand scenarios overnight and find strategies no human would. We've retired it. AlphaGo had a perfect simulator, a free reward signal, stationary rules, symmetric self-play. This domain has none of the four: it's partially observable, the adversary adapts to you specifically, and outcomes are sometimes unobservable for years.

So the real question is what replaces the reward when the reward is unobservable, and what a self-play equilibrium means when the simulator is itself a hypothesis. If your instinct reading the AlphaGo line was that it breaks, that's the instinct this role runs on.

**What you'd work on**

* **Adversaries worth the name:**
  Not a scripted opponent, not a critique template. Something that finds the alternative explanation, isolates the assumption doing the most work and tests it, and notices the evidence that should exist if a conclusion were true and doesn't.
* **Attacking our own system:**
  Poisoning, injection embedded in material it will read, saturation, probing. An adversary who learns what your system reacts to has learned more than the data itself would give up. Then building the defences and proving they hold.
* **Knowing whether any of it works:**
  When nobody reviews every output individually, correctness stops being answerable by inspection. Held-out ground truth, scoring by question class, variance across runs, drift detection. We think this is a bigger engineering artifact than the agents themselves. Most teams build it last.
* **Whether we're making humans worse:**
  People shown a fluent machine assessment anchor on it, and their own reasoning measurably degrades. Raising apparent throughput while quietly degrading judgment makes the institution worse while every dashboard improves. Designing the trials that catch this is part of the job.

The deepest problem here: generating objections is trivial, models do it endlessly. Telling a critique that finds a real flaw from one that's merely well-formed is not, and as far as we can tell it's unsolved.

**Who this is for**

An unusual role for an unusual person. Constitutionally sceptical, rigorous rather than reflexive about it. More excited by an experiment that disproves something than a demo that impresses someone. Able to argue for a flaw against people who don't want to hear it, including us.

Useful backgrounds: adversarial ML, security research, multi-agent systems, RL, game theory, forecasting and calibration, causal inference, experimental design. Rarer and valuable: real grounding in statistics or philosophy of science alongside the engineering. No defence background needed. No seniority needed.

title: Lead, Penetration Testing
description:
**Job Summary**
We are seeking talented and motivated individuals for the role of Senior Manager / Lead Penetration Testing. Provide deep, hands-on penetration testing expertise for Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT), blockchain, smart contract and API-based solutions. The role independently identifies exploitable security weaknesses, translates technical findings into business risk, and works closely with developers, architects, platform teams and security stakeholders to remediate issues. The role also brings current cyber-security and blockchain industry insight, uses AI-assisted security testing responsibly, applies extensive Java engineering skills to build security and QA automation frameworks, helps QA teams accelerate maintainable test automation, and includes the wider team in technical decisions through evidence-based recommendations and recognised best practices.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy and Technical Leadership**

* Act as a senior individual contributor and subject-matter expert for penetration testing across smart contracts, APIs, web applications, blockchain platforms and supporting infrastructure.
* Define risk-based penetration-test approaches covering black-box, grey-box and authenticated testing, aligned to system criticality, threat models and regulatory expectations.
* Maintain deep awareness of emerging cyber threats, blockchain vulnerabilities, attack techniques, defensive controls and relevant industry developments.
* Assess new tools and testing techniques, including AI-assisted approaches, and recommend adoption based on effectiveness, safety, explainability and control requirements.
* Bring engineers, security specialists and relevant team members into technical decisions, clearly presenting options, evidence, trade-offs and recommended practices.

**Security Testing and Assurance**

* Plan and execute end-to-end penetration testing of smart contracts, REST and event-driven APIs, web services, microservices, blockchain nodes, wallets, key-management integrations and supporting cloud or container platforms.
* Conduct manual and automated smart contract security testing, including source-code review, static and dynamic analysis, fuzzing, invariant testing and, where appropriate, formal-verification techniques.
* Use smart contract security tools hands-on, including Slither for static analysis, Mythril and Manticore for symbolic execution, Foundry and Echidna for fuzzing and invariant testing, and Certora for formal verification, selecting tools according to the assurance objective and validating all outputs manually.
* Create and maintain custom Slither detectors, Foundry test suites, Echidna properties and reusable smart contract security test harnesses where standard rules are insufficient.
* Test for blockchain-specific weaknesses such as reentrancy, access-control failures, oracle manipulation, front-running or MEV exposure, flash-loan abuse, unchecked external calls, upgradeability weaknesses, denial of service and cross-chain trust failures.
* Perform API testing covering authentication and authorisation, object-level and function-level access controls, token and session handling, input validation, injection, rate limiting, business-logic abuse, sensitive-data exposure and service-to-service trust.
* Assess common application, network and platform weaknesses using manual exploitation and appropriate tooling, while ensuring testing is authorised, controlled and non-disruptive.
* Validate identified weaknesses, establish realistic attack paths and distinguish exploitable risk from tool-generated noise or false positives. ge and efficiency without weakening professional judgement or accountability.

**AI-assisted Penetration Testing**

* Use approved AI-enabled security tools to accelerate attack-surface discovery, test-case generation, code and smart-contract review, payload variation, evidence analysis and report preparation.
* Apply human validation to all AI-generated findings and recommendations; protect confidential information and ensure use remains within authorised testing scope and organisational policy.
* Explore how adversaries may use AI to find, chain or exploit weaknesses, and incorporate relevant scenarios into controlled security assessments.
* Develop repeatable automation and AI-assisted workflows that improve coverage and efficiency without weakening professional judgement or accountability.

**Java Engineering and Automation Development**

* Demonstrate extensive hands-on coding experience in Java, including strong knowledge of object-oriented design, collections, concurrency, exception handling, secure coding, dependency management, unit testing and reusable framework design.
* Design and develop maintainable Java-based penetration-testing and QA automation utilities, libraries and frameworks for API, integration, regression and security testing.
* Build API automation using Java with REST Assured or equivalent frameworks, including authentication, request construction, schema and payload validation, negative testing, response assertions and test-data management.
* Develop UI automation using Java with Selenium or equivalent approved frameworks, applying Page Object Model, reusable components, robust waits, stable locators and parallel execution patterns.
* Use Java testing ecosystems such as JUnit or TestNG, Maven or Gradle, Cucumber, mock frameworks and reporting libraries, and integrate automated suites with Git-based workflows and CI/CD pipelines.
* Review Java automation code for security, maintainability, test reliability, performance and reuse; coach QA engineers on coding practices, debugging and framework extension.

**Responsibilities**
**AI-enabled QA Automation and Enablement**

* Demonstrate extensive practical experience using approved generative-AI and coding-assistant tools to accelerate the design, creation, review and maintenance of automated test cases.
* Partner with QA engineers to identify automation opportunities and convert requirements, acceptance criteria, user journeys and API specifications into reusable positive, negative, boundary, regression and security test scenarios.
* Help QA teams select and apply fit-for-purpose tools, patterns and frameworks for UI, API, contract, integration and regression automation, while avoiding unnecessary tool proliferation.
* Create reference implementations, reusable prompts, templates, utilities and coding standards that enable QA engineers to develop automation faster and consistently.
* Provide hands-on guidance using enterprise-approved AI coding assistants with frameworks such as Playwright or Selenium for UI testing; Postman/Newman, REST Assured or Karate for API automation; and Cucumber for behaviour-driven test design.
* Use AI to assist with test-case generation, test-data creation, script scaffolding, locator and assertion recommendations, failure analysis, defect summaries and maintenance suggestions, subject to human review and validation.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, define quality gates and reporting, and ensure generated tests are traceable to requirements, deterministic, maintainable and suitable for regulated environments.
* Coach QA and development teams on responsible AI usage, including data confidentiality, prompt hygiene, secure coding, intellectual-property considerations and verification of generated outputs.

Remediation and Engineering Partnership
  
  

* Work directly with developers, DevSecOps, architects, product owners and platform teams to explain root cause, exploitation paths, business impact and practical remediation options.
* Provide secure design and coding recommendations for Solidity, APIs, identity, cryptography, secrets, wallets, blockchain integrations and distributed-system trust boundaries.
* Retest fixes, verify closure and identify residual risk, compensating controls or remediation dependencies.
* Contribute security test cases and controls to CI/CD pipelines and support shift-left security through threat modelling, design review and developer enablement.
* Produce concise, threat-based reports for technical and senior audiences, with reproducible evidence, severity rationale, remediation ownership and prioritisation.

**Skills And Experience**
Extensive hands-on black-box, grey-box and authenticated penetration testing across applications, APIs, networks and cloud-native platforms; ability to validate exploitability, attack paths and business impact.
  
  
Hands-on audits of Solidity/EVM smart contracts; identify reentrancy, access-control, oracle, front-running/MEV, flash-loan, upgradeability, cross-chain and business-logic weaknesses.
  
  
Extensive Java coding for reusable security and QA automation frameworks. Working proficiency in Python and JavaScript for tooling, test automation and blockchain/API testing.
  
  
Design, develop, review and maintain reliable automated test suites; reusable framework design; positive, negative, boundary, regression and security cases; debugging and code review.
  
  
Strong RESTful API testing methodology; authentication/authorisation, schema/payload validation, negative testing, business logic, rate limits and service-to-service trust.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Extensive use of approved AI coding assistants to accelerate test design, script generation, test data, assertions and failure analysis; validate outputs with human oversight and protect confidential data.
  
  
Validate transaction processing, consensus/finality assumptions, node behaviour, wallet functionality, cryptographic protocols, smart-contract invariants and deterministic behaviour where AI components interact with DLT.
  
  
Strong manual-testing methods; create comprehensive, traceable test strategies, plans, scenarios, cases and evidence; apply risk-based and exploratory testing.
  
  
Integrate security and functional automation into pipelines; define quality gates, execution reporting, deterministic runs and defect traceability.
  
  
Strong SQL, complex query development and database testing across transactional and integration flows.
  
  
Apply threat modelling and current application, API and smart-contract security standards; remain current on cyber, blockchain and DLT threats.
  
  
Work directly with developers, QA, DevSecOps and architects to explain root cause, recommend fixes, retest closure and communicate residual risk to technical and senior audiences.
  
  
Relevant hands-on blockchain/DLT or digital-assets industry experience; senior individual contributor who includes the team in decisions and provides evidence-based recommendations and best practices.
  
  
Design and execute load, stress and endurance tests; analyse results and isolate application, database, infrastructure or integration bottlenecks.
  
  
Practical familiarity with blockchain development, testing libraries, local networks, oracle integration and blockchain APIs.
  
  
Develop custom Slither detectors, fuzz properties, invariant suites and formal specifications for critical controls and accounting logic.
  
  
Use platform and observability tools to investigate failures, validate runtime behaviour and support DevSecOps testing.
  
  
Test model-output quality, consistency, safety and real-time behaviour in decentralised workflows; assess how non-deterministic AI outputs are controlled before deterministic smart-contract execution.
  
  
Understanding of permissioned and public DLT, DeFi, tokenisation, Layer 2, cross-chain architectures, DAOs and NFTs.
  
  
Practical offensive-security or application-security certification, supplemented by demonstrable hands-on capability.
  
  
Ability to learn new languages, tools and frameworks, share knowledge and support multi-skilling within an agile scrum team.

* Collaborate with AI engineering, platform, and development teams to embed security throughout the SDLC and CI/CD pipelines, including AI\-specific development workflows.
* Develop, evaluate, and document security measures, controls, and guardrails to protect data, applications, APIs, and infrastructure across cloud and AI environments.

* Develop and maintain scripts, automated solutions, and security tooling to streamline security processes, vulnerability identification, and compliance checks across cloud and AI environments.
* Stay current on emerging threats across cloud, AI/ML, and security engineering domains, including adversarial ML techniques, cloud\-native attack vectors, and evolving regulatory requirements.
* Lead and mentor technical security teams; influence senior stakeholders and align security posture with business objectives.

 Qualifications

* 12\+ years of hands\-on experience in cybersecurity, with depth spanning in the following domains:
+ Cloud Security: Architecting and assessing security for cloud\-native and hybrid environments across major CSPs (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI).
+ Security Engineering: Building security tooling, automation, detection capabilities, or secure\-by\-design systems at scale.
+ AI Engineering Security: Securing AI/ML systems, LLM\-based applications, agentic pipelines, or ML infrastructure.

* ***Winning as One Team:***
*We work together with universal respect to achieve aligned outcomes*
* ***Customer Driven Innovation:***
*We innovate to stay ahead of the market and create value for our customers*
* ***Agility in Action:***
*We embrace change and are unified in our purpose and objectives amidst change*



  





*Join us as we redefine cybersecurity, innovate fearlessly, and grow together as one team.* 




  





**Role Summary:** 




  





 The Senior Support Specialist is a senior security practitioner responsible for defending the organization’s network, infrastructure, and cloud environments against internal and external threats. This role operates at the intersection of security engineering and operations, with direct ownership of network security controls, threat detection, and incident response. Support responsibilities exist to enable security outcomes, not as an end in themselves.
 



 This position requires hands\-on expertise, sound judgment under pressure, and the ability to identify systemic risk before it becomes an incident.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities:** 




  





**Network Security Ownership** 



* Architect, deploy, and continuously harden network security controls including firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, segmentation, and zero\-trust access models.
* Own network perimeter and internal trust boundaries, including firewall policy design, rule lifecycle management, and access validation.
* Actively monitor network traffic and telemetry to identify indicators of compromise, lateral movement, and policy violations.
* Lead vulnerability discovery and remediation for network and infrastructure components.



  





**Threat Detection \& Incident Response** 



* Serve as the primary escalation point for all security incidents involving network intrusion, unauthorized access, malware, or data exposure.
* Perform deep forensic analysis using logs, packet captures, and endpoint data to determine scope and impact.
* Contain, eradicate, and recover from incidents while preserving evidence and maintaining operational continuity.
* Drive post\-incident root cause analysis and ensure corrective controls are implemented, not merely documented.



  





**Security Operations Engineering** 



* Maintain and tune security tooling including SIEM, NDR, EDR/XDR, and vulnerability management platforms.
* Define detection logic, alert thresholds, and response playbooks aligned to real threat models rather than checkbox compliance.
* Reduce noise and false positives while improving time\-to\-detect and time\-to\-contain metrics.



  





**Security\-Driven Support \& Escalation** 



* Handle only the most complex escalations where security risk, system integrity, or availability is at stake.
* Enforce secure configuration standards across systems, networks, and cloud services.
* Mentor support and IT staff on secure operational practices and adversarial thinking.



  





**Risk, Governance \& Assurance** 



* Translate security policy and control requirements into enforceable technical reality.
* Support audits and assessments by producing defensible, technically accurate evidence.
* Continuously assess gaps between documented controls and actual security posture.



  





**Architecture \& Strategic Hardening** 



* Influence infrastructure and application design decisions to reduce attack surface and blast radius.
* Identify architectural weaknesses and advocate for durable, long\-term security improvements.
* Track emerging threats and adjust defensive strategies accordingly.



  





**Required Experience:** 




  




* 7\+ years in security engineering, network security, SOC, or infrastructure defense roles.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with enterprise networking and security architectures.
* Proven incident response experience involving real\-world security events.
* Strong understanding of attacker techniques, lateral movement, and network\-based threats.
* Experience securing cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).



  





**Preferred Experience:** 




  




* Security certifications (CISSP, GSEC, GCIA, CySA\+, or equivalent).
* Experience operating within SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar frameworks.
* Scripting or automation capability to improve detection, response, or control enforcement.
* Background supporting SaaS, high\-availability, or distributed environments.



  





**What Success Looks Like:** 




  




* Security incidents are detected earlier and contained faster.
* Network access is tightly controlled, auditable, and aligned with least\-privilege principles.
* Recurring issues are eliminated through structural fixes rather than repeated response.
* Security is embedded into daily operations, not bolted on after failures.



  





**Benefits:** 




  





 As a full\-time employee with Securonix, you will be eligible for the following employee benefits:
 



  




* Health Insurance with a total sum insured is INR 7,50,000
* Coverage: Self, Spouse, 2 kids, Dependent parents, or parents\-in\-law

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, and transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

title: Security Consultant
description:
Job Description
 




  





 We are seeking an experienced
 **Security Professional** 
 to provide technical leadership and hands\-on expertise across
 **Data Security, IBM Data Activity Monitoring (DAM), Cloud Security, Database Security, Application Security, Kubernetes/EKS, IAM, and enterprise security integrations** 
 .
 



  





 Security SME will be responsible for the architecture, design, implementation, integration, rollout, operation, troubleshooting, hardening, and continuous improvement of the Cloud Security, DAM Appliance and broader data\-security environment. SME role will work closely with the practice teams to ensure security controls align with
 **Zero Trust, least privilege, defense\-in\-depth, regulatory requirements, and enterprise security standards** 
 .
 



  






 Key Responsibilities.
 









* Serve as the
 **Security SME for IBM Data Activity Monitoring (DAM) and Cloud Security** 
 , providing end\-to\-end expertise across security architecture, solution design, implementation, configuration, integration, troubleshooting, and operational support.
* Lead the
 **implementation, rollout, onboarding, and operationalization of IBM DAM** 
 across enterprise applications, databases, data sources, APIs, and critical business use cases, ensuring appropriate monitoring, auditability, and security coverage.
* Design, implement, and maintain
 **DAM security policies, monitoring rules, roles, entitlements, data\-access controls, authorization mechanisms, and security baselines** 
 aligned with enterprise security and compliance requirements.
* Perform DAM platform
 **health checks, performance monitoring, capacity planning, tuning, troubleshooting, optimization, and lifecycle management** 
 to maintain platform stability, availability, and security.
* Lead the onboarding of applications, databases, data sources, and new business use cases into DAM, defining appropriate monitoring requirements, access controls, audit policies, and security controls.
* Manage
 **vulnerability remediation, security patching, configuration hardening, version upgrades, and technology lifecycle activities** 
 across the DAM technology stack.
* Provide L2/L3 technical support and troubleshooting for complex
 **IBM DAM, E\-STAP, EKS/Kubernetes, DAM appliances, agents, database connectivity, policies, and security integrations** 
 , including incident investigation and root\-cause analysis.
* Design and implement secure access controls for
 **databases, applications, APIs, cloud workloads, and enterprise data platforms** 
 , applying
 **Zero Trust, least privilege, need\-to\-know, and segregation\-of\-duties principles** 
 .
* Conduct periodic
 **access reviews and entitlement assessments** 
 to identify excessive, inappropriate, dormant, orphaned, or conflicting access and coordinate remediation with application, database, IAM, and business owners.
* Develop and maintain
 **enterprise data\-security standards, technical security controls, configuration baselines, SOPs, operational runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles** 
 .
* Review
 **cloud and hybrid\-cloud architectures** 
 to identify security risks, vulnerabilities, trust\-boundary issues, excessive privileges, insecure configurations, data\-exposure risks, and integration weaknesses, providing actionable remediation recommendations.
* Support
 **cloud migration and transformation initiatives** 
 by embedding security architecture, data protection, identity and access management, encryption, monitoring, compliance, and regulatory requirements into solution designs.
* Apply
 **Zero Trust, defense\-in\-depth, secure\-by\-design, least privilege, and risk\-based security principles** 
 across cloud, database, Kubernetes/EKS, application, and enterprise data environments.
* Perform
 **threat modeling and security assessments** 
 for applications, APIs, databases, cloud workloads, Kubernetes/EKS environments, and enterprise data platforms using
 **STRIDE, attack\-surface analysis, abuse\-case analysis, trust\-boundary analysis, and threat identification** 
 .
* Identify
 **attack vectors, vulnerabilities, architectural weaknesses, trust\-boundary violations, security\-control gaps, and potential business impacts** 
 , translating findings into actionable security requirements and remediation plans.
* Conduct
 **security architecture and solution\-design reviews** 
 covering authentication, authorization, privileged access, network segmentation, data protection, encryption, logging, monitoring, API security, and third\-party integrations.
* Integrate threat\-modeling and security\-review outcomes into
 **architecture, solution design, application development, cloud migration, and security\-control implementation** 
 , ensuring security requirements are addressed throughout the technology lifecycle.
* Partner with
 **application, development, architecture, cloud, infrastructure, database, DevOps, and platform teams** 
 to embed security\-by\-design principles and provide technical security guidance throughout project delivery.
* Investigate
 **DAM security events and incidents** 
 , perform root\-cause analysis, coordinate remediation, and implement permanent corrective actions to prevent recurrence and improve overall security posture.
* Support
 **risk assessments, vulnerability assessments, audits, compliance reviews, control assessments, and remediation tracking** 
 related to DAM, cloud, database, and enterprise data security.
* Participate in
 **solution architecture reviews, proof\-of\-concepts, technical evaluations, technology selections, and implementation activities** 
 , providing security recommendations and technical assurance.
* Drive
 **continuous improvement initiatives** 
 to strengthen DAM and data\-security posture, improve monitoring and visibility coverage, increase operational efficiency, automate repetitive security processes, and enhance platform reliability.
* Prepare and present
 **weekly and monthly security\-status reports** 
 covering implementation progress, risks, vulnerabilities, incidents, issues, remediation activities, key metrics, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Maintain current knowledge of
 **IBM Security technologies, DAM capabilities, cloud\-security technologies, Kubernetes/EKS security, emerging threats, vulnerabilities, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices** 
 , recommending improvements to strengthen the enterprise security posture.










 Required Skills \& Experience
 



* 10\+ years of Cybersecurity / IAM / Data Security experience with strong enterprise security exposure.
* Expert hands\-on experience with IBM Guardium / IBM Data Activity Monitoring (DAM), including architecture, implementation, configuration, policies, monitoring, onboarding, troubleshooting, and operations.
* Strong expertise in IBM Guardium S\-TAP / E\-STAP, database activity monitoring, sensitive\-data monitoring, and security policy management.
* Good knowledge of Database Security, including PostgreSQL, and MySQL.
* Strong expertise in IAM, PAM, authorization, entitlement management, and least privilege.
* Strong experience securing Kubernetes / Amazon EKS, including RBAC, secrets, service accounts, network policies, and workload security.
* Experience integrating DAM, IAM, PAM, SIEM/SOC, vulnerability\-management, and enterprise security platforms.
* Strong understanding of Zero Trust, defense\-in\-depth, encryption, key management, secrets management, and data protection.
* Threat Modeling experience, including STRIDE, attack\-surface analysis, threat identification, risk assessment, security control mapping, and remediation recommendations across cloud, applications, APIs, databases, and data platforms.
* Proven experience in security hardening, vulnerability remediation, incident troubleshooting, access reviews, risk assessments, and compliance.
* Strong L2/L3 troubleshooting, technical leadership, architecture, documentation, and stakeholder\-management capabilities.



  






 Certifications
 



* AWS Security Specialty
* CCSP

title: Director, DevSecOps (AI-First)
description:
If you've spent the last decade building platform and security in fast\-moving product companies, and lately found yourself thinking"most of what my team does could be an agent"— this is the role.
 



**The tension we're hiring you to resolve** 




 Jupiter is a regulated fintech. \~370 repos, \~50 engineers, live money moving 24×7, RBI\-supervised partnerships (CSB, Federal), PCI\-DSS card issuance, DPDP obligations, a multi\-cloud AWS \+ OCI estate, dozens of Account Aggregator and bureau integrations. Under normal physics, you'd staff this surface with a 15\-person platform team plus a 15\-person AppSec org — the size of our entire engineering team.
 



**We don't want either.** 




 We already run one of the most AI\-augmented pipelines in Indian fi ntech — our internal agent
 



 Jarvis ships real code, triages alerts, and reviews PRs across the whole estate every day. Our engineers move fast because the paved road is intelligent. We want the same for platform and security together. That's your job.
 



**What "AI\-first DevSecOps" means at Jupiter** 




 Not "we bought a Copilot license.
 


* " It means: Deployment orchestration, capacity planning, incident triage, CVE work, threat modeling, IaC review, cost anomaly detection — all designed as agent loops first, human\-supervised and continuously improved
* Every "senior SRE would have caught this rollback" and every "senior AppSec would have caught this XSS" becomes a repeatable, evaluated agent check — codified, not tribal
* Deploy latency, incident MTTR, security\-review latency, unit cost per transaction —metrics you drive down quarterly, not queues you defend
* Auditors and partners get automated evidence packs, not spreadsheet marathons



**What you'll actually own** 




**Platform / DevOps** 



* The paved road for shipping: CI/CD, Spinnaker deploy pipelines, build systems, feature flags, release gates
* Cloud \+ Kubernetes across a multi\-cloud estate (AWS \+ OCI, multiple accounts); IaC (Terraform \+Terragrunt for cloud, Helm 3 \+ Kustomize for K8s) as the source of truth
* Observability platform: logs, metrics, traces, alerting as a product engineers want to use
* SRE practice: on\-call, incident command, error budgets, capacity \+ cost engineering
* Developer experience: local dev, preview environments, secrets provisioning, self\-serve infra



**Security** 



* AppSec paved road: SAST / DAST / SBOM / secret\-scan / IaC scan/dependency CVE triage —as PR checks that don't get routed around
* Cloud \+ K8s security posture; IAM boundaries, network segmentation for partner integrations
* Threat modeling on every new service touching money, PII, or a partner API
* Incident response: detection, containment, forensics, post\-mortems
* RBI cyber framework, PCI\-DSS, DPDP — as artifacts your pipelines emit, not documents your team writes; future\-ready for ISO 27001 / SOC 2 when we choose to pursue them
* Direct interface with banking partners and regulators on our security \+ reliability posture



**Experience \& background we're looking for** 



* Non\-negotiable 15\+ years total in software engineering, of which 8\+ years hands\-on across DevOps / Platform / SRE and Application / Cloud Security (real depth in both — not "managed a team that did it")
* 6\+ years leading engineering teams, at least 2 as second\-line (managing managers or senior ICs)
* 3\+ years in a regulated industry — fintech, banking, healthtech, or an equivalent audit\-heavyenvironment. You've been through at least one RBI / PCI\-DSS (or equivalent) audit as an owner, not a bystander. SOC 2 / ISO 27001 experience is a plus.
* Deep AWS \+ Kubernetes production experience (multi\-account, IAM, VPC, EKS, IaC via Terraform / Terragrunt \+ Helm / Kustomize). OCI experience is a plus.
* Hands\-on with modern LLM tooling (Claude / GPT / agentic frameworks) for real engineering work — you've shipped or heavily used AI dev tools in the last 12 months, not just experimented
* Can read Kotlin, Scala, and TypeScript comfortably; write Python fluently



**Strong plus** 



* Previously built the DevSecOps function at an Indian fintech under RBI supervision
* Ran incident command for a Sev\-1 that touched customer money — and led the post\-mortem
* Public work: OSS contributions to security or platform tooling, conference talks, technical blog with depth
* Certifications: CISSP / CCSP / OSCP (security), CKA / CKS (Kubernetes), AWS Security Specialty nice signals but we care about what you've shipped, not what you've certified
* History of hiring and retaining strong ICs (references we can call)



**Explicit non\-requirements** 



* MBA / management degree — irrelevant here
* Big\-Tech (FAANG) tenure — nice signal, not required; we've seen more Jupiter\-fit talent from product startups than from BigCo
* Prior "Director" title — if you're a Principal / Staff who's been operating at Director scope, apply



**You know it's you if…** 



* You've shipped platform tooling and security tooling that engineers didn't route around both
* You can read Kotlin, Scala, and TypeScript, and you write Python without thinking about it
* You've owned an on\-call rota you'd want to be on
* You've been hands\-on with Claude / GPT / agentic frameworks for real work — not just chat
* You've run platform or security in a regulated environment and know what a real audit feels like
* You believe the future infra \+ security leader is 30% engineer, 30% agent\-builder, 40% coach —and you're excited about the middle 30%



**You should probably skip this if…** 



* You want to lead a large team from day one (small strong team, senior\-IC\-heavy, is by design)
* You prefer governance to building
* You're skeptical that agents can do meaningful platform or security work — we'd rather hire someone who's already proven it to themselves
* You want to specialize in only one side (only Sec, only DevOps) — the whole point of this role is one strong leader across both



**The offer** 



* Reports directly to the President.
* Board\-level visibility on infra \+ security posture.
* Small strong team, budget to build (tooling, agents, headcount as we scale).
* Bangalore, work from office.
* Comp calibrated to senior director / VP band at leading Indian fintechs.

**What You Bring**
* BE/BTech in Computer Science, Information Security, Electronics, or a related field.

title: Sr Staff Research Engineer
description:
**Our Mission**
 At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
   

  

****Who We Are****
 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

****Job Summary****
**The Team**
 As the intelligence engine behind our Next\-Generation Security platform, Palo Alto Networks’ Cloud\-Delivered Security Services (CDSS) drives global cybersecurity initiatives on a massive scale. Joining the CDSS team means contributing to a foundational security backbone that very few organizations worldwide can match.
   

  

 Directly tied to our mission of thwarting cyber threats, our research division serves as the core of our product ecosystem. We continuously push boundaries, redefining traditional security concepts and proactively establishing industry standards rather than following them. Our researchers embrace uncharted territory, developing novel solutions for unprecedented challenges. We are looking for talented professionals who thrive in ambiguous environments, welcome complex problem\-solving, and feel inspired to mitigate the hidden risks of our digital landscape by ensuring a robust, secure environment.
   

  

******Job Summary******
 Our core CASB research team is seeking a motivated, highly strategic, and technically sound Sr. Staff Security Researcher. In this role, you will drive global technical leadership and innovation, pioneering advanced research initiatives to defend against sophisticated cyberattacks. You will partner with principal researchers and cross\-functional engineering leadership to architect cutting\-edge threat detection capabilities across our Strata, Prisma, and Cortex portfolios.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
 Core Responsibilities, Research \& Innovation
   

  

* Lead deep\-dive security research into complex SaaS applications, API architectures, and cloud environments to architect pioneering data protection and threat prevention technologies.
* Spearhead the design and conceptualization of next\-generation inline inspection algorithms and security controls to safeguard sensitive data across enterprise cloud ecosystems.
* Define the strategic direction for self\-directed security research, investigating novel attack vectors, emerging threat behaviors, and evasive adversary tactics.
* Conduct comprehensive protocol and traffic analysis to formulate robust network security countermeasures against highly targeted attacks.


 Automation, AI \& Advanced Analytics
   

  

* Architect and scale high\-throughput automated analysis frameworks for real\-time traffic ingestion, payload decoding, and telemetry processing.
* Leverage advanced AI/ML models, deep learning, and anomaly detection paradigms to analyze live network communications and enhance threat mitigation efficacy.
* Develop custom tools, automated research pipelines, and AI\-assisted workflows to accelerate the research life cycle and optimize operational efficiency.


 Collaboration \& Product Integration
   

  

* Collaborate closely with senior engineering and research leaders across product boundaries to drive multi\-functional security initiatives and platform integrations.
* Translate complex research discoveries and threat intelligence into production\-grade protections across Palo Alto Networks' security suite.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level researchers, fostering technical excellence, peer collaboration, and rigorous research methodologies within the team.
* Serve as a subject matter expert, effectively communicating research insights, technical whitepapers, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership and key stakeholders.


****Qualifications****
* Experience: 4\-9 years of dedicated, hands\-on experience in security research, network security, and threat analysis.
* Deep technical expertise in network protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP/S, TLS, DNS), web APIs, and modern SaaS infrastructure.
* Mastery of packet\-level inspection and traffic analysis tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler, OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite).
* Advanced proficiency in Python, Go, or JavaScript for building production\-grade research tooling and automation pipelines.
* Proven track record of architecting scalable data processing, ingestion, and automation systems.
* Demonstrated success in leading end\-to\-end, high\-impact security research programs from inception to deployment.
* Recognized expertise in emerging cyber threats, vulnerability research, and advanced DLP/CASB techniques.
* Exceptional analytical, problem\-solving, and critical thinking skills with an ability to navigate complex ambiguity.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with a strong history of technical documentation, publication, or public presentation.


******Preferred Qualifications******
* Cloud Platforms: Extensive experience designing, deploying, and securing enterprise cloud infrastructure in AWS, GCP, Azure, or OCI.
* AI \& Machine Learning: Deep practical experience applying machine learning algorithms, deep neural networks, or multi\-agent systems to threat detection and cybersecurity problems.
* AI Tooling Proficiency: Hands\-on experience integrating LLMs, generative AI tools, and automated coding assistants into workflow automation and log analysis systems.
* Front\-End \& Architecture Knowledge: Foundational understanding of modern web application frameworks and front\-end architectures to aid in application research.


**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
   

  

 Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160\+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE\-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in\-line cloud security platform.
   

  

 We believe the future of work is Human \+ AI and are building an AI\-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
   

  

**Role**
 We are building security products that enable organizations to adopt AI applications and agents safely and at scale. This is a hybrid capacity based in Bangalore role, reporting to the Director of Software Engineering. You will act as a hands\-on Senior Software Engineer leading key product capabilities, taking full ownership of complex technical initiatives, shaping architectural direction, and guiding other engineers.
   

  

**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**
* Lead the design and delivery of major product capabilities, owning projects from problem definition through implementation, rollout, and production operation.
* Design secure, reliable, and scalable systems with clearly defined trust boundaries, making technical decisions that balance security, privacy, performance, reliability, and usability.
* Lead complex investigations while improving engineering practices, testing, and operational readiness.
* Mentor engineers and provide direction through design and code reviews.
* Partner with product and research teams while contributing to technical strategy and longer\-term architecture.


**Who You Are (Success Profile)**
* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high\-level strategy and hands\-on execution.
* You are a problem\-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser\-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high\-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.


**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**
* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI\-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain.
* 3\-4 years of software\-engineering experience, including ownership of complex production systems and a demonstrated ability to lead technically ambiguous, cross\-functional projects.
* Deep expertise in systems engineering, distributed systems, security engineering, backend platforms, or endpoint software, combined with strong proficiency in Go, Rust, and Python.
* Experience designing systems with clear security, privacy, and reliability requirements, alongside a strong understanding of concurrency, networking, storage, APIs, and operational observability.
* Experience in managing Cloud Infrastructure on one of the Hyperscalers: AWS, GCP, or Azure.


**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**
* Experience building security, cloud, or enterprise software, including endpoint software for Windows, MacOS, and Linux.
* Familiarity with AI applications, agents, developer platforms, or AI security.

title: Principal Applications Security Architect
description:
